lxx: ΚAI ἐγένετο μετὰ τὸ αἰχμαλωτισθῆναι τὸν Ἰσραὴλ καὶ Ἰερουσαλήμ ἐρημωθῆναι ἐκάθισεν Ἱερεμίας κλαίων, καὶ ἐθρήνησεν τὸν θρῆνον τοῦτον ἐπὶ Ἰερουσαλὴμ καὶ εἶπεν

wlc: אֵיכָה יָשְׁבָה בָדָד הָעִיר רַבָּתִי עָם הָיְתָה כְּאַלְמָנָה רַבָּתִי בַגּוֹיִם שָׂרָתִי בַּמְּדִינוֹת הָיְתָה לָמַס ׃ ס
lxx: Ἄλεφ. Πῶς ἐκάθισεν μόνη ἡ πόλις ἡ πεπληθυμμένη λαῶν; ἐγενήθη ὡς χήρα πεπληθυμμένη ἐν ἔθνεσιν, ἄρχουσα ἐν χώραις ἐγενήθη εἰς φόρον.
vulg: ALEPH quomodo sedit sola civitas plena populo facta est quasi vidua domina gentium princeps provinciarum facta est sub tributo
clem: Prologus Et factum est, postquam in captivitatem redactus est Isral, et Jerusalem deserta est, sedit Jeremias propheta flens, et planxit lamentatione hac in Jerusalem: et amaro animo suspirans et ejulans, dixit: [ Aleph Quomodo sedet sola civitas plena populo! Facta est quasi vidua domina gentium; princeps provinciarum facta est sub tributo.
kjv: How doth the city sit solitary, that was full of people! how is she become as a widow! she that was great among the nations, and princess among the provinces, how is she become tributary!

wlc: בָּכוֹ תִבְכֶּה בַּלַּיְלָה וְדִמְעָתָהּ עַל לֶחֱיָהּ אֵין־לָהּ מְנַחֵם מִכָּל־אֹהֲבֶיהָ כָּל־רֵעֶיהָ בָּגְדוּ בָהּ הָיוּ לָהּ לְאֹיְבִים ׃ ס
lxx: Ἄλεφ. Κλαίουσα ἔκλαυσεν ἐν νυκτί, καὶ τὰ δάκρυα αὐτῆς ἐπὶ τῶν σιαγόνων αὐτῆς, καὶ οὐχ ὑπάρχει ὁ παρακαλῶν αὐτὴν ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἀγαπώντων αὐτὴν· πάντες οἱ φιλοῦντες αὐτὴν ἠθέτησαν ἐν αὐτῇ, ἐγένοντο αὐτή εἰς ἐχθρούς.
vulg: BETH plorans ploravit in nocte et lacrimae eius in maxillis eius non est qui consoletur eam ex omnibus caris eius omnes amici eius spreverunt eam et facti sunt ei inimici
clem: Beth Plorans ploravit in nocte, et lacrim ejus in maxillis ejus: non est qui consoletur eam, et omnibus caris ejus; omnes amici ejus spreverunt eam, et facti sunt ei inimici.
kjv: She weepeth sore in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks: among all her lovers she hath none to comfort her: all her friends have dealt treacherously with her, they are become her enemies.

wlc: גָּלְתָה יְהוּדָה מֵעֹנִי וּמֵרֹב עֲבֹדָה הִיא יָשְׁבָה בַגּוֹיִם לֹא מָצְאָה מָנוֹחַ כָּל־רֹדְפֶיהָ הִשִּׂיגוּהָ בֵּין הַמְּצָרִים ׃ ס
lxx: Γἱμελ Μετῳκίσθη Ἰουδαία ἀπὸ ταπεινώσεως αὐτῆς καὶ ἀπὸ πλήθους δουλείας αὐτῆς· ἐκάθισεν ἐν ἔθνεσιν, οὐχ εἶρεν ἀνάπαυσιν· πάντες οἱ καταδιώκοντες αὐτὴν κατέλαβον αὐτὴν ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν θλιβόντων.
vulg: GIMEL migravit Iuda propter adflictionem et multitudinem servitutis habitavit inter gentes nec invenit requiem omnes persecutores eius adprehenderunt eam inter angustias
clem: Ghimel Migravit Judas propter afflictionem, et multitudinem servitutis; habitavit inter gentes, nec invenit requiem: omnes persecutores ejus apprehenderunt eam inter angustias.
kjv: Judah is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude: she dwelleth among the heathen, she findeth no rest: all her persecutors overtook her between the straits.

wlc: דַּרְכֵי צִיּוֹן אֲבֵלוֹת מִבְּלִי בָּאֵי מוֹעֵד כָּל־שְׁעָרֶיהָ שׁוֹמֵמִין כֹּהֲנֶיהָ נֶאֱנָחִים בְּתוּלֹתֶיהָ נוּגוֹת וְהִיא מַר־לָהּ ׃ ס
lxx: Δάλεθ. Ὁδοὶ Σειὼν πενθοῦσιν παρὰ τὸ μὴ εἰναι ἐρχομένους ἐν ἑορτῇ· πᾶσαι αἱ πύλαι αὐτῆς ἠφανισμέναι, οἱ ἱερεῖς αὐτῆς ἀναστενάζουσιν, αἱ παρθένοι αὐτῆς ἀγόμεναι, καὶ αὐτὴ πικραινομένη ἐν ἑαυτῇ.
vulg: DELETH viae Sion lugent eo quod non sint qui veniant ad sollemnitatem omnes portae eius destructae sacerdotes eius gementes virgines eius squalidae et ipsa oppressa amaritudine
clem: Daleth Vi Sion lugent, eo quod non sint qui veniant ad solemnitatem: omnes port ejus destruct, sacerdotes ejus gementes; virgines ejus squalid, et ipsa oppressa amaritudine.
kjv: The ways of Zion do mourn, because none come to the solemn feasts: all her gates are desolate: her priests sigh, her virgins are afflicted, and she is in bitterness.

wlc: הָיוּ צָרֶיהָ לְרֹאשׁ אֹיְבֶיהָ שָׁלוּ כִּי־יְהוָה הוֹגָהּ עַל רֹב־פְּשָׁעֶיהָ עוֹלָלֶיהָ הָלְכוּ שְׁבִי לִפְנֵי־צָר ׃ ס
lxx: Ἥ Ἐγένοντο οἱ θλίκδοντες αὐτὴν εἰς κεφαλήν. καὶ οἱ ἐχθροὶ αὐτῆς εὐθηνοῦσαν, ὅτι Κύριος ἐταπείνωσεν ἐπὶ τὸ πλῆθος τῶν ἀσεβειῶν αὐτῆς· τὰ νήπια αὐτῆς ἐπορεύθησαν ἐν αίχμαλαωσίᾳ κατὰ πρόκωποι θλίβοντος.
vulg: HE facti sunt hostes eius in capite inimici illius locupletati sunt quia Dominus locutus est super eam propter multitudinem iniquitatum eius parvuli eius ducti sunt captivi ante faciem tribulantis
clem: He Facti sunt hostes ejus in capite; inimici ejus locupletati sunt: quia Dominus locutus est super eam propter multitudinem iniquitatum ejus. Parvuli ejus ducti sunt in captivitatem ante faciem tribulantis.
kjv: Her adversaries are the chief, her enemies prosper; for the Lord hath afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions: her children are gone into captivity before the enemy.

wlc: וַיֵּצֵא מִן בַּת־צִיּוֹן כָּל־הֲדָרָהּ הָיוּ שָׂרֶיהָ כְּאַיָּלִים לֹא־מָצְאוּ מִרְעֶה וַיֵּלְכוּ בְלֹא־כֹחַ לִפְנֵי רוֹדֵף ׃ ס
lxx: Οὐαύ Καὶ ἐξήρθη ἐκ θυγατρὸς Σειὼν πᾶσα ἡ εὐπρέπεια αὐτῆς· ἐγένοντο οἱ ἄρχοντες αὐτῆς ὡς κριοὶ οὐχ είρίσκοντες νομὴν. καὶ ἐπορεύοντο ἐν οὐκ ἰσχύι κατὰ πρόσωπον διώκοντος.
vulg: VAV et egressus est a filia Sion omnis decor eius facti sunt principes eius velut arietes non invenientes pascuam et abierunt absque fortitudine ante faciem subsequentis
clem: Vau Et egressus est a filia Sion omnis decor ejus; facti sunt principes ejus velut arietes non invenientes pascua, et abierunt absque fortitudine ante faciem subsequentis.
kjv: And from the daughter of Zion all her beauty is departed: her princes are become like harts that find no pasture, and they are gone without strength before the pursuer.

wlc: זָכְרָה יְרוּשָׁלַםִ יְמֵי עָנְיָהּ וּמְרוּדֶיהָ כֹּל מַחֲמֻדֶיהָ אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ מִימֵי קֶדֶם בִּנְפֹל עַמָּהּ בְּיַד־צָר וְאֵין עוֹזֵר לָהּ רָאוּהָ צָרִים שָׂחֲקוּ עַל מִשְׁבַּתֶּהָ ׃ ס
lxx: Ζάιν. Ἐμνήσθη Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἡμερῶν ταπεινώσεως αὐτῆς καὶ ἀπωσμῶι αὐτῆς, πάντα τὰ ἐπιθυμητὰ αὐτῆς ὅσα ἤν ἐξ ἡμερῶν ἀρχαίων. ἐν τῷ πεσεῖν τὸν λαὸν αὐτῆς εἰς χεῖρας θλίβοντος, καὶ οὐκ ἦι ὁ βοηθῶν αὐτῇ· ἰδόντες οἱ ἐχθροὶ αὐτῆς ἐγέλασαν ἐπὶ κατοικεσίᾳ αὐτῆς.
vulg: ZAI recordata est Hierusalem dierum adflictionis suae et praevaricationis omnium desiderabilium suorum quae habuerat a diebus antiquis cum caderet populus eius in manu hostili et non esset auxiliator viderunt eam hostes et deriserunt sabbata eius
clem: Zain Recordata est Jerusalem dierum afflictionis su, et prvaricationis, omnium desiderabilium suorum, qu habuerat a diebus antiquis, cum caderet populus ejus in manu hostili, et non esset auxiliator: viderunt eam hostes, et deriserunt sabbata ejus.
kjv: Jerusalem remembered in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that she had in the days of old, when her people fell into the hand of the enemy, and none did help her: the adversaries saw her, and did mock at her sabbaths.

wlc: חֵטְא חָטְאָה יְרוּשָׁלַםִ עַל־כֵּן לְנִידָה הָיָתָה כָּל־מְכַבְּדֶיהָ הִזִּילוּהָ כִּי־רָאוּ עֶרְוָתָהּ גַּם־הִיא נֶאֶנְחָה וַתָּשָׁב אָחוֹר ׃ ס
lxx: Ἤθ. ʼΑμαρτίαν ἥμαρτεν Ἰερουσαλήμ, διὰ τοῦτο εἰς σάλον ἐγένετο· πάντες οἱ δοξάζοντες αὐτὴν ἐταπείνωσαν αὐτήν· ἴδον γὰρ τὴν ἀσχημοσύνην αὐτῆς, καί γε αὐτὴ στενάζουσα καὶ ἀπεστράφη ὀπίσω.
vulg: HETH peccatum peccavit Hierusalem propterea instabilis facta est omnes qui glorificabant eam spreverunt illam quia viderunt ignominiam eius ipsa autem gemens et conversa retrorsum
clem: Heth Peccatum peccavit Jerusalem, propterea instabilis facta est; omnes qui glorificabant eam spreverunt illam, quia viderunt ignominiam ejus: ipsa autem gemens conversa est retrorsum.
kjv: Jerusalem hath grievously sinned; therefore she is removed: all that honoured her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: yea, she sigheth, and turneth backward.

wlc: טֻמְאָתָהּ בְּשׁוּלֶיהָ לֹא זָכְרָה אַחֲרִיתָהּ וַתֵּרֶד פְּלָאִים אֵין מְנַחֵם לָהּ רְאֵה יְהוָה אֶת־עָנְיִי כִּי הִגְדִּיל אוֹיֵב ׃ ס
lxx: Τήθ. Ἀκαθαρσία αὐτῆς πρὸς ποδῶν αὐτῆς, οὐκ ἐμνήσθη ἔσχατα αὐτῆς καὶ κατεβίβασεν ὑπέρογκα· οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ παρακαλῶν αὐτήν. ἴδὲ, Κύριε, τὴν ταπείνωσίν μου, ὅτι ἐμεγαλύνθη ἐχθρός.
vulg: TETH sordes eius in pedibus eius nec recordata est finis sui deposita est vehementer non habens consolatorem vide Domine adflictionem meam quoniam erectus est inimicus
clem: Teth Sordes ejus in pedibus ejus, nec recordata est finis sui; deposita est vehementer, non habens consolatorem. Vide, Domine, afflictionem meam, quoniam erectus est inimicus.
kjv: Her filthiness is in her skirts; she remembereth not her last end; therefore she came down wonderfully: she had no comforter. O Lord, behold my affliction: for the enemy hath magnified himself.

wlc: יָדוֹ פָּרַשׂ צָר עַל כָּל־מַחֲמַדֶּיהָ כִּי־רָאֲתָה גוֹיִם בָּאוּ מִקְדָּשָׁהּ אֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתָה לֹא־יָבֹאוּ בַקָּהָל לָךְ ׃ ס
lxx: Ἰώθ. Κεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐξεπέτασεν θλίβων ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ ἐπιθυμήματα αὐτῆς, εἶδεν γὰρ ἔθνη εἰσελθόντα εἰς τὸ ἁγίασμα αὐτῆς, ἄ ἐνετείλω μὴ εἰσελθεῖν αὐτὰ εἰς ἐκκλησίαν σου.
vulg: IOTH manum suam misit hostis ad omnia desiderabilia eius quia vidit gentes ingressas sanctuarium suum de quibus praeceperas ne intrarent in ecclesiam tuam
clem: Jod Manum suam misit hostis ad omnia desiderabilia ejus, quia vidit gentes ingressas sanctuarium suum, de quibus prceperas ne intrarent in ecclesiam tuam.
kjv: The adversary hath spread out his hand upon all her pleasant things: for she hath seen that the heathen entered into her sanctuary, whom thou didst command that they should not enter into thy congregation.

wlc: כָּל־עַמָּהּ נֶאֱנָחִים מְבַקְּשִׁים לֶחֶם נָתְנוּ מַחֲמוֹדֵּיהֶם בְּאֹכֶל לְהָשִׁיב נָפֶשׁ רְאֵה יְהוָה וְהַבִּיטָה כִּי הָיִיתִי זוֹלֵלָה ׃ ס
lxx: Χάφ. Πᾶς ὁ λαὸς αὐτῆς καταστενάζοντες, ζητοῦντες ἄρτον. ἔδωκαν τὰ ἐπιθυμήματα αὐτῆς ἐν βρώσει τοῦ ἐπιστρέψαι δὲ, Κύριε, καὶ ἐπίβλεψον, ὅτι ἐγενήθη ἠτιμωμένη.
vulg: CAPH omnis populus eius gemens et quaerens panem dederunt pretiosa quaeque pro cibo ad refocilandam animam vide Domine considera quoniam facta sum vilis
clem: Caph Omnis populus ejus gemens, et qurens panem; dederunt pretiosa quque pro cibo ad refocillandam animam. Vide, Domine, et considera quoniam facta sum vilis!
kjv: All her people sigh, they seek bread; they have given their pleasant things for meat to relieve the soul: see, O Lord, and consider; for I am become vile.

wlc: לוֹא אֲלֵיכֶם כָּל־עֹבְרֵי דֶרֶךְ הַבִּיטוּ וּרְאוּ אִם־יֵשׁ מַכְאוֹב כְּמַכְאֹבִי אֲשֶׁר עוֹלַל לִי אֲשֶׁר הוֹגָה יְהוָה בְּיוֹם חֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ ׃ ס
lxx: Αάμεδ. Οἱ πρὸς ὑμᾶς πάντες παραπορευόμενοι ὁδόν, ἐπιστρέψατε καὶ ἴδετε εἰ ἔστιν ἄλγος κατὰ τὸ ἄλγος μου ὅ ἐγενήθη· φθεγξάμενος ἐν ἐμοὶ ἐταπείνωσέν με Κύριος ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ργῆς θυμοῦ αὐτοῦ.
vulg: LAMED o vos omnes qui transitis per viam adtendite et videte si est dolor sicut dolor meus quoniam vindemiavit me ut locutus est Dominus in die irae furoris sui
clem: Lamed O vos omnes qui transitis per viam, attendite, et videte si est dolor sicut dolor meus! quoniam vindemiavit me, ut locutus est Dominus, in die ir furoris sui.
kjv: Is it nothing to you, all ye that pass by? behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is done unto me, wherewith the Lord hath afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger.

wlc: מִמָּרוֹם שָׁלַח־אֵשׁ בְּעַצְמֹתַי וַיִּרְדֶּנָּה פָּרַשׂ רֶשֶׁת לְרַגְלַי הֱשִׁיבַנִי אָחוֹר נְתָנַנִי שֹׁמֵמָה כָּל־הַיּוֹם דָּוָה ׃ ס
lxx: Μήμ. Ἐζ ὕψους αὐτοῦ ἀπέστειλεν πῦρ, ἐν τοῖς ὀστέοις μου κατήγαγεν αὐτό· διεπέτασεν δίκτυον τοῖς ποσίν μου, ἀπέστρεψέν με εἰς τὰ ὀπίσσω, ἔδωκέν με ἠφανισμένην, ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν ὀδυνωμένην.
vulg: MEM de excelso misit ignem in ossibus meis et erudivit me expandit rete pedibus meis convertit me retrorsum posuit me desolatam tota die maerore confectam
clem: Mem De excelso misit ignem in ossibus meis, et erudivit me: expandit rete pedibus meis, convertit me retrorsum; posuit me desolatam, tota die mrore confectam.
kjv: From above hath he sent fire into my bones, and it prevaileth against them: he hath spread a net for my feet, he hath turned me back: he hath made me desolate and faint all the day.

wlc: נִשְׂקַד עֹל פְּשָׁעַי בְּיָדוֹ יִשְׂתָּרְגוּ עָלוּ עַל־צַוָּארִי הִכְשִׁיל כֹּחִי נְתָנַנִי אֲדֹנָי בִּידֵי לֹא־אוּכַל קוּם ׃ ס
lxx: Nούν. Ἐγρηγορήθη ἐπὶ τὰ ἀσεβήματά μου. ἐν χερσίν μου συνεπλάκησαν, ἀνέβησαν ἐπὶ τὸν τράχηλόν ἠσθένησεν ἡ ἰσχύς μου, ὅτι ἔδωκεν Κύριος ἐν χερσίν μου ὀδύνας, οὐ δυνήσομαι στῆναι.
vulg: NUN vigilavit iugum iniquitatum mearum in manu eius convolutae sunt et inpositae collo meo infirmata est virtus mea dedit me Dominus in manu de qua non potero surgere
clem: Nun Vigilavit jugum iniquitatum mearum; in manu ejus convolut sunt, et imposit collo meo. Infirmata est virtus mea: dedit me Dominus in manu de qua non potero surgere.
kjv: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand: they are wreathed, and come up upon my neck: he hath made my strength to fall, the Lord hath delivered me into their hands, from whom I am not able to rise up.

wlc: סִלָּה כָל־אַבִּירַי אֲדֹנָי בְּקִרְבִּי קָרָא עָלַי מוֹעֵד לִשְׁבֹּר בַּחוּרָי גַּת דָּרַךְ אֲדֹנָי לִבְתוּלַת בַּת־יְהוּדָה ׃ ס
lxx: Σάμχ. Ἐξῆρεν πάντας τοὺς ἰσχυρούς μου ὁ κύριος ἐκ μέσου μου, ἐκάλεσεν ἐπʼ ἐμε καιρὸν τοῦ συντρίψαι ἐκλεκτούς μου· ληνὸν ἐπάτησεν Κύριος παρθένῳ θυγατρὶ Ἰούδα, ἐπὶ τούτοις ἐγὼ κλαίω.
vulg: SAMECH abstulit omnes magnificos meos Dominus de medio mei vocavit adversum me tempus ut contereret electos meos torcular calcavit Dominus virgini filiae Iuda
clem: Samech Abstulit omnes magnificos meos Dominus de medio mei; vocavit adversum me tempus ut contereret electos meos. Torcular calcavit Dominus virgini fili Juda.
kjv: The Lord hath trodden under foot all my mighty men in the midst of me: he hath called an assembly against me to crush my young men: the Lord hath trodden the virgin, the daughter of Judah, as in a winepress.

wlc: עַל־אֵלֶּה אֲנִי בוֹכִיָּה עֵינִי עֵינִי יֹרְדָה מַּיִם כִּי־רָחַק מִמֶּנִּי מְנַחֵם מֵשִׁיב נַפְשִׁי הָיוּ בָנַי שׁוֹמֵמִים כִּי גָבַר אוֹיֵב ׃ ס
lxx: Ἅιν. Ὁ ὀφθαλμός μου κατήγαγεν ὕδωρ, ὅτι ἐμακρύνθη ἀπʼ ἐμοῦ ὁ παρακαλῶν με, ὁ ἐπιστρέφων ψυχήν μου· ἐγένοντο οἱ υἱοί μου ἠφανισμένοι, ὅτι ἐκραταιώθη ὁ ἐχθρός.
vulg: AIN idcirco ego plorans et oculus meus deducens aquam quia longe factus est a me consolator convertens animam meam facti sunt filii mei perditi quoniam invaluit inimicus
clem: Ain Idcirco ego plorans, et oculus meus deducens aquas, quia longe factus est a me consolator, convertens animam meam. Facti sunt filii mei perditi, quoniam invaluit inimicus.
kjv: For these things I weep; mine eye, mine eye runneth down with water, because the comforter that should relieve my soul is far from me: my children are desolate, because the enemy prevailed.

wlc: פֵּרְשָׂה צִיּוֹן בְּיָדֶיהָ אֵין מְנַחֵם לָהּ צִוָּה יְהוָה לְיַעֲקֹב סְבִיבָיו צָרָיו הָיְתָה יְרוּשָׁלַםִ לְנִדָּה בֵּינֵיהֶם ׃ ס
lxx: Φή. Διεπετασεν Σειὼν χεῖρας αὐτῆς, οὐκ ἔστιν ὁ παρακαλῶν αὐτήν. ἐνετείλατο Κύριος τῷ Ἰακώβ· κύκλῳ αὐτοῦ οἱ θλίκδοντες αὐτόν, ἐγενήθη Ἰερουσαλὴμ εἰς ἀποκαθημένην ἀνὰ μέσον αὐτῶυ.
vulg: FE expandit Sion manus suas non est qui consoletur eam mandavit Dominus adversum Iacob in circuitu eius hostes eius facta est Hierusalem quasi polluta menstruis inter eos
clem: Phe Expandit Sion manus suas; non est qui consoletur eam. Mandavit Dominus adversum Jacob in circuitu ejus hostes ejus; facta est Jerusalem quasi polluta menstruis inter eos.
kjv: Zion spreadeth forth her hands, and there is none to comfort her: the Lord hath commanded concerning Jacob, that his adversaries should be round about him: Jerusalem is as a menstruous woman among them.

wlc: צַדִּיק הוּא יְהוָה כִּי פִיהוּ מָרִיתִי שִׁמְעוּ־נָא כָל־עַמִּים וּרְאוּ מַכְאֹבִי בְּתוּלֹתַי וּבַחוּרַי הָלְכוּ בַשֶּׁבִי ׃ ס
lxx: Γωδή. Δίκαιός ἐστιν Κύριος, ὅτι στόμα αὐτοῦ παρεπίκρανα. ἀκούσατε δή, πάντες οἱ λαοί, καὶ ἴδετε τὸ ἄλγος μου· παρθένοι μου καὶ νεανίσκοι μου ἐπορεύθησαν ἐν αἰχμαλωσίᾳ.
vulg: SADE iustus est Dominus quia os eius ad iracundiam provocavi audite obsecro universi populi et videte dolorem meum virgines meae et iuvenes mei abierunt in captivitatem
clem: Sade Justus est Dominus, quia os ejus ad iracundiam provocavi. Audite, obsecro, universi populi, et videte dolorem meum: virgines me et juvenes mei abierunt in captivitatem.
kjv: The Lord is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: hear, I pray you, all people, and behold my sorrow: my virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.

wlc: קָרָאתִי לַמְאַהֲבַי הֵמָּה רִמּוּנִי כֹּהֲנַי וּזְקֵנַי בָּעִיר גָּוָעוּ כִּי־בִקְשׁוּ אֹכֶל לָמוֹ וְיָשִׁיבוּ אֶת־נַפְשָׁם ׃ ס
lxx: Κώφ. Ἐκάλεσα τοὺς ἐραστάς μου, αὐτοὶ δὲ παρελογίσαντό με· οἱ ἱερεῖς μου καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροί μου ἐν τῇ πόλει ἐξέλειπον, ὅτι ἐζήτησαν βρῶσιν αὐτοῖς ἴνα ἐπιστρέψωσιν ψυχὰς αὐτῶν, καὶ οὐχ εὗρον.
vulg: COPH vocavi amicos meos et ipsi deceperunt me sacerdotes mei et senes mei in urbe consumpti sunt quia quaesierunt cibum sibi ut refocilarent animam suam
clem: Coph Vocavi amicos meos, et ipsi deceperunt me; sacerdotes mei et senes mei in urbe consumpti sunt, quia qusierunt cibum sibi ut refocillarent animam suam.
kjv: I called for my lovers, but they deceived me: my priests and mine elders gave up the ghost in the city, while they sought their meat to relieve their souls.

wlc: רְאֵה יְהוָה כִּי־צַר־לִי מֵעַי חֳמַרְמָרוּ נֶהְפַּךְ לִבִּי בְּקִרְבִּי כִּי מָרוֹ מָרִיתִי מִחוּץ שִׁכְּלָה־חֶרֶב בַּבַּיִת כַּמָּוֶת ׃ ס
lxx: Ῥήχς. Ἵδε, Κύριε, ὅτι θλίμβομαι· ἡ κοιλία μου ἐταράχθη, καὶ ἡ καρδία μου ἐστράφη ἐν ἐμοί ὅτι παραπικραίνουσα παρεπικράνθην, ἔξωθεν ἠτέκνωσεν μάχαιρα ὥσπερ θάνατος ἐν οἴκῳ.
vulg: RES vide Domine quoniam tribulor venter meus conturbatus est subversum est cor meum in memet ipsa quoniam amaritudine plena sum foris interfecit gladius et domi mors similis est
clem: Res Vide, Domine, quoniam tribulor: conturbatus est venter meus, subversum est cor meum in memetipsa, quoniam amaritudine plena sum. Foris interfecit gladius, et domi mors similis est.
kjv: Behold, O Lord; for I am in distress: my bowels are troubled; mine heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: abroad the sword bereaveth, at home there is as death.

wlc: שָׁמְעוּ כִּי נֶאֱנָחָה אָנִי אֵין מְנַחֵם לִי כָּל־אֹיְבַי שָׁמְעוּ רָעָתִי שָׂשׂוּ כִּי אַתָּה עָשִׂיתָ הֵבֵאתָ יוֹם־קָרָאתָ וְיִהְיוּ כָמוֹנִי ׃ ס
lxx: Χσέν. Ἀκούσατε δὴ ὅτι στενάζω ἐγώ, οὐκ ἔστιυ ὁ παρακαλῶν με· πάντες οἱ ἐχθροί μου ἤκουσαν τὰ κακά μου καὶ ἐχάρησαν, ὅτι σὺ ἐποίησας· ἐπήγαγες ἡμέραν, ἐκάλεσας καιρόν, ἐγένοντο ὄμοιοι ἐμοί.
vulg: SEN audierunt quia ingemesco ego et non est qui consoletur me omnes inimici mei audierunt malum meum laetati sunt quoniam tu fecisti adduxisti diem consolationis et fient similes mei
clem: Sin Audierunt quia ingemisco ego, et non est qui consoletur me; omnes inimici mei audierunt malum meum, ltati sunt quoniam tu fecisti: adduxisti diem consolationis, et fient similes mei.
kjv: They have heard that I sigh: there is none to comfort me: all mine enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that thou hast done it: thou wilt bring the day that thou hast called, and they shall be like unto me.

wlc: תָּבֹא כָל־רָעָתָם לְפָנֶיךָ וְעוֹלֵל לָמוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁר עוֹלַלְתָּ לִי עַל כָּל־פְּשָׁעָי כִּי־רַבּוֹת אַנְחֹתַי וְלִבִּי דַוָּי ׃ פ
lxx: Θαύ. Εἰσέλθοι πᾶσα ἡ κακία αὐτῶν κατὰ πρόσωπόν σου, καὶ ἐπιφύλλισον αὐτοῖς ὃν τρόπον ἐποίησαν ἐπιφυλλίδα περὶ πάντων τῶν ἁμαρτημάταον μου, ὅτι πολλοὶ οἱ στεναγμοί μου, καὶ ἡ καρδία μου λυπεῖται.
vulg: THAU ingrediatur omne malum eorum coram te et devindemia eos sicut vindemiasti me propter omnes iniquitates meas multi enim gemitus mei et cor meum maerens
clem: Thau Ingrediatur omne malum eorum coram te: et vindemia eos, sicut vindemiasti me propter omnes iniquitates meas: multi enim gemitus mei, et cor meum mrens.]
kjv: Let all their wickedness come before thee; and do unto them, as thou hast done unto me for all my transgressions: for my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.

wlc: אֵיכָה יָעִיב בְּאַפּוֹ אֲדֹנָי אֶת־בַּת־צִיּוֹן הִשְׁלִיךְ מִשָּׁמַיִם אֶרֶץ תִּפְאֶרֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא־זָכַר הֲדֹם־רַגְלָיו בְּיוֹם אַפּוֹ ׃ ס
lxx: Ἄλεφ. Πῶς ἐγνόφωσεν ἐν ὀργῇ αὐτοῦ Κύριος τὴν θυγατέρα Σειών· κατερριψεν ἐξ οὐρανοῦ εἰς γῆν δόξασμα Ἰσραήλ, καὶ οὐκ ἐμνήσθη ὑποποδίου ποδῶν αὐτοῦ.
vulg: ALEPH quomodo obtexit caligine in furore suo Dominus filiam Sion proiecit de caelo terram inclitam Israhel et non recordatus est scabilli pedum suorum in die furoris sui
clem: [ Aleph Quomodo obtexit caligine in furore suo Dominus filiam Sion; projecit de clo in terram inclytam Isral, et non est recordatus scabelli pedum suorum in die furoris sui!
kjv: How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger, and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel, and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger!

wlc: בִּלַּע אֲדֹנָי לֹא חָמַל אֵת כָּל־נְאוֹת יַעֲקֹב הָרַס בְּעֶבְרָתוֹ מִבְצְרֵי בַת־יְהוּדָה הִגִּיעַ לָאָרֶץ חִלֵּל מַמְלָכָה וְשָׂרֶיהָ ׃ ס
lxx: Βήθ. Ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ὀργῆς αὐτοῦ ¹κατεπόντισεν Κύριος, οὐ φεισάμενος· πάντα τὰ ὡραῖα Ἰακὼβ καθεῖλεν ἐν θυμῷ αὐτοῦ, τὰ ὀχυρώματα τῆς θυγατρὸς Ἰούδα ἐκόλλησεν εἰς τὴν γῆν, ἐβεβήλωσεν βασιλέας αὐτῆς καὶ ἄρχοντας αὐτῆς.
vulg: BETH praecipitavit Dominus nec pepercit omnia speciosa Iacob destruxit in furore suo munitiones virginis Iuda deiecit in terram polluit regnum et principes eius
clem: Beth Prcipitavit Dominus, nec pepercit omnia speciosa Jacob: destruxit in furore suo muntiones virginis Juda, et dejecit in terram; polluit regnum et principes ejus.
kjv: The Lord hath swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob, and hath not pitied: he hath thrown down in his wrath the strong holds of the daughter of Judah; he hath brought them down to the ground: he hath polluted the kingdom and the princes thereof.

wlc: גָּדַע בָּחֳרִי־אַף כֹּל קֶרֶן יִשְׂרָאֵל הֵשִׁיב אָחוֹר יְמִינוֹ מִפְּנֵי אוֹיֵב וַיִּבְעַר בְּיַעֲקֹב כְּאֵשׁ לֶהָבָה אָכְלָה סָבִיב ׃ ס
lxx: Γίμελ Συνεκάλεσεν ἐν ὀργῇ θυμοῦ αὐτοῦ πᾶν κέρας Ἰσραήλ, ἀπέστρεψεν ὀπίσω δεξιὰν αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ προσώπου ἐχθροῦ, καὶ ἀνῆψεν ἐν Ἰακὼβ ὡς πῦρ φλόγα, καὶ κατέφαγεν πάντα τὰ κύκλῳ.
vulg: GIMEL confregit in ira furoris omne cornu Israhel avertit retrorsum dexteram suam a facie inimici et succendit in Iacob quasi ignem flammae devorantis in gyro
clem: Ghimel Confregit in ira furoris sui omne cornu Isral; avertit retrorsum dexteram suam a facie inimici, et succendit in Jacob quasi ignem flamm devorantis in gyro.
kjv: He hath cut off in his fierce anger all the horn of Israel: he hath drawn back his right hand from before the enemy, and he burned against Jacob like a flaming fire, which devoureth round about.

wlc: דָּרַךְ קַשְׁתּוֹ כְּאוֹיֵב נִצָּב יְמִינוֹ כְּצָר וַיַּהֲרֹג כֹּל מַחֲמַדֵּי־עָיִן בְּאֹהֶל בַּת־צִיּוֹן שָׁפַךְ כָּאֵשׁ חֲמָתוֹ ׃ ס
lxx: Δάλεθ. Ἐνέτεινεν τόξον αὐτοῦ ὡς ἐχθρὸς ὑπεναντίος, ἐστερέωσεν δεξιὰν αὐτοῦ ὁὡς ὑπεναντίος, καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν πάντα τὰ ἐπιθυμήματα ὀφθαλμῶν μου ἐν σκηνῇ θυγατρὸς Σειών, ἐξέχεεν ὡς πῦρ τὸν θυμὸν αὐτοῦ.
vulg: DELETH tetendit arcum suum quasi inimicus firmavit dexteram suam quasi hostis et occidit omne quod pulchrum erat visu in tabernaculo filiae Sion effudit quasi ignem indignationem suam
clem: Daleth Tetendit arcum suum quasi inimicus, firmavit dexteram suam quasi hostis, et occidit omne quod pulchrum erat visu in tabernaculo fili Sion; effudit quasi ignem indignationem suam.
kjv: He hath bent his bow like an enemy: he stood with his right hand as an adversary, and slew all that were pleasant to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion: he poured out his fury like fire.

wlc: הָיָה אֲדֹנָי כְּאוֹיֵב בִּלַּע יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּלַּע כָּל־אַרְמְנוֹתֶיהָ שִׁחֵת מִבְצָרָיו וַיֶּרֶב בְּבַת־יְהוּדָה תַּאֲנִיָּה וַאֲנִיָּה ׃ ס
lxx: H ʼἘγενήθη Κύριος ὡς ἐχθρός, κατεπόντισεν Ἰσραήλ· κατεπόντισεν τὰς βάρεις αὐτῆς, διέφθειρεν τὰ ὀχυράματα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπλήθυνεν τῇ θυγατρὶ Ἰούδα ταπεινουμένην καὶ τεταπειναομένην.
vulg: HE factus est Dominus velut inimicus praecipitavit Israhel praecipitavit omnia moenia eius dissipavit munitiones eius et replevit in filia Iuda humiliatum et humiliatam
clem: He Factus est Dominus velut inimicus, prcipitavit Isral: prcipitavit omnia mnia ejus, dissipavit munitiones ejus, et replevit in filia Juda humiliatum et humiliatam.
kjv: The Lord was as an enemy: he hath swallowed up Israel, he hath swallowed up all her palaces: he hath destroyed his strong holds, and hath increased in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.

wlc: וַיַּחְמֹס כַּגַּן שֻׂכּוֹ שִׁחֵת מוֹעֲדוֹ שִׁכַּח יְהוָה בְּצִיּוֹן מוֹעֵד וְשַׁבָּת וַיִּנְאַץ בְּזַעַם־אַפּוֹ מֶלֶךְ וְכֹהֵן ׃ ס
lxx: Οὐαό. Καὶ διεπέτασεν ὡς ἄμπελον τὸ σκήνωμα αὐτοῦ, διέφθειρεν ἑορτὴν αὐτοῦ· ἐπελάθετο Κύριος ἃ ἐποίησεν ἐν Σειὼν ἑορτῆς καὶ σαββάτου, καὶ παρώξυνεν ἐνβριμήματι ὀργῆς αὐτοῦ βασιλέα καὶ ἱερέα καὶ ἄρχοντα.
vulg: VAV et dissipavit quasi hortum tentorium suum demolitus est tabernaculum suum oblivioni tradidit Dominus in Sion festivitatem et sabbatum et obprobrio in indignatione furoris sui regem et sacerdotem
clem: Vau Et dissipavit quasi hortum tentorium suum; demolitus est tabernaculum suum. Oblivioni tradidit Dominus in Sion festivitatem et sabbatum; et in opprobrium, et in indignationem furoris sui, regem et sacerdotem.
kjv: And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were of a garden: he hath destroyed his places of the assembly: the Lord hath caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion, and hath despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest.

wlc: זָנַח אֲדֹנָי מִזְבְּחוֹ נִאֵר מִקְדָּשׁוֹ הִסְגִּיר בְּיַד־אוֹיֵב חוֹמֹת אַרְמְנוֹתֶיהָ קוֹל נָתְנוּ בְּבֵית־יְהוָה כְּיוֹם מוֹעֵד ׃ ס
lxx: Ζάιν. Ἀπώσατο Κύριος θυσιαστήριον αὐτοῦ, ἀπετίναξεν ἁγίασμα αὐτοῦ, συνέτριψεν ἐν χειρὶ αὐτοῦ τεῖχος βάρεων αὐτῆς· φωνὴν ἔδωκαν ἐν οἴκῳ ὡς ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἑορτῆς.
vulg: ZAI reppulit Dominus altare suum maledixit sanctificationi suae tradidit in manu inimici muros turrium eius vocem dederunt in domo Domini sicut in die sollemni
clem: Zain Repulit Dominus altare suum; maledixit sanctificationi su: tradidit in manu inimici muros turrium ejus. Vocem dederunt in domo Domini sicut in die solemni.
kjv: The Lord hath cast off his altar, he hath abhorred his sanctuary, he hath given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces; they have made a noise in the house of the Lord, as in the day of a solemn feast.

wlc: חָשַׁב יְהוָה לְהַשְׁחִית חוֹמַת בַּת־צִיּוֹן נָטָה קָו לֹא־הֵשִׁיב יָדוֹ מִבַּלֵּעַ וַיַּאֲבֶל־חֵל וְחוֹמָה יַחְדָּו אֻמְלָלוּ ׃ ס
lxx: ‟Ηθ. Καὶ ἐπέστρεψεν διαφθεῖραι τεῖχος θυγατρὸς Σειών· ἐξέτεινεν μέτρον, οὐκ ἐπέστρεψεν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ καταπατήματος, καὶ ἐπένθησεν τὸ προτείχισμα, καὶ τεῖχος ὁμοθυμαδὸν ἡσθένησεν.
vulg: HETH cogitavit Dominus dissipare murum filiae Sion tetendit funiculum suum et non avertit manum suam a perditione luxitque antemurale et murus pariter dissipatus est
clem: Heth Cogitavit Dominus dissipare murum fili Sion; tetendit funiculum suum, et non avertit manum suam a perditione: luxitque antemurale, et murus pariter dissipatus est.
kjv: The Lord hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion: he hath stretched out a line, he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying: therefore he made the rampart and the wall to lament; they languished together.

wlc: טָבְעוּ בָאָרֶץ שְׁעָרֶיהָ אִבַּד וְשִׁבַּר בְּרִיחֶיהָ מַלְכָּהּ וְשָׂרֶיהָ בַגּוֹיִם אֵין תּוֹרָה גַּם־נְבִיאֶיהָ לֹא־מָצְאוּ חָזוֹן מֵיְהוָה ׃ ס
lxx: Tήθ. Ἐνεπάγησαν εἰς γῆν πύλαι αὐτῆς· ἀπώλεσεν καὶ συνέτριψεν μοχλοὺς αὐτῆς, βασιλέα αὐτῆς καὶ ἄρχοντας αὐτῆς ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν· οὐκ ἔστιν νόμος, καί γε προφῆτι αὐτῆς οὐκ εἶδον ὄρασιν παρὰ Κυρίου.
vulg: TETH defixae sunt in terra portae eius perdidit et contrivit vectes eius regem eius et principes eius in gentibus non est lex et prophetae eius non invenerunt visionem a Domino
clem: Teth Defix sunt in terra port ejus, perdidit et contrivit vectes ejus; regem ejus et principes ejus in gentibus: non est lex, et prophet ejus non invenerunt visionem a Domino.
kjv: Her gates are sunk into the ground; he hath destroyed and broken her bars: her king and her princes are among the Gentiles: the law is no more; her prophets also find no vision from the Lord.

wlc: יֵשְׁבוּ לָאָרֶץ יִדְּמוּ זִקְנֵי בַת־צִיּוֹן הֶעֱלוּ עָפָר עַל־רֹאשָׁם חָגְרוּ שַׂקִּים הוֹרִידוּ לָאָרֶץ רֹאשָׁן בְּתוּלֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָם ׃ ס
lxx: Ἰώδ. Ἐκάθισαν εἰς τὴν γῆν, ἐσιώπησαν πρεσβύτεροι θυγατρὸς Σειών, ἀνεβίβδασαν χοῦν ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτῶν, περιεζώσαντο σάκκους, κατήγαγον εἰς γῆν ἀρχηγοὺς παρθένους ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ.
vulg: IOTH sederunt in terra conticuerunt senes filiae Sion consperserunt cinere capita sua accincti sunt ciliciis abiecerunt in terra capita sua virgines Hierusalem
clem: Jod Sederunt in terra, conticuerunt senes fili Sion; consperserunt cinere capita sua, accincti sunt ciliciis: abjecerunt in terram capita sua virgines Jerusalem.
kjv: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground, and keep silence: they have cast up dust upon their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloth: the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.

wlc: כָּלוּ בַדְּמָעוֹת עֵינַי חֳמַרְמְרוּ מֵעַי נִשְׁפַּךְ לָאָרֶץ כְּבֵדִי עַל־שֶׁבֶר בַּת־עַמִּי בֵּעָטֵף עוֹלֵל וְיוֹנֵק בִּרְחֹבוֹת קִרְיָה ׃ ס
lxx: Χάφ. Ἐξέλειπον ἐν δάκρυσιν οἱ ὀφθαλμοί μου, ἐταράχθη ἡ καρδία ἐξεχύθη εἰς τὴν γῆν ἡ δόξα μου, ἐπὶ τὸ σύντριμμα τῆς θυγατρὸς λαοῦ μου, ἐν τῷ ἐκλιπεῖν νήπιον καὶ θηλάζοντα ἐν πλατείαις πόλεως.
vulg: CAPH defecerunt prae lacrimis oculi mei conturbata sunt viscera mea effusum est in terra iecur meum super contritione filiae populi mei cum deficeret parvulus et lactans in plateis oppidi
clem: Caph Defecerunt pr lacrimis oculi mei, conturbata sunt viscera mea; effusum est in terra jecur meum super contritione fili populi mei, cum deficeret parvulus et lactens in plateis oppidi.
kjv: Mine eyes do fail with tears, my bowels are troubled, my liver is poured upon the earth, for the destruction of the daughter of my people; because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city.

wlc: לְאִמֹּתָם יֹאמְרוּ אַיֵּה דָּגָן וָיָיִן בְּהִתְעַטְּפָם כֶּחָלָל בִּרְחֹבוֹת עִיר בְּהִשְׁתַּפֵּךְ נַפְשָׁם אֶל־חֵיק אִמֹּתָם ׃ ס
lxx: Λάβδ. Ταῖς μητράσιν αὐτῶν εἶπαν Ιοῦ σῖτος καὶ οἶνος; ἐν τῷ ἐκλύεσθαι αὐτοὺς ὡς τραυματίας ἐν πλατείαις πόλεως, ἐν τῷ ἐκχεῖσθαι ψυχὰς αὐτῶν εἰς κόλπον μητέρων αὐτῶν.
vulg: LAMED matribus suis dixerunt ubi est triticum et vinum cum deficerent quasi vulnerati in plateis civitatis cum exhalarent animas suas in sinu matrum suarum
clem: Lamed Matribus suis dixerunt: Ubi est triticum et vinum? cum deficerent quasi vulnerati in plateis civitatis, cum exhalarent animas suas in sinu matrum suarum.
kjv: They say to their mothers, Where is corn and wine? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul was poured out into their mothers' bosom.

wlc: מָה־אֲעִידֵךְ מָה אֲדַמֶּה־לָּךְ הַבַּת יְרוּשָׁלַםִ מָה אַשְׁוֶה־לָּךְ וַאֲנַחֲמֵךְ בְּתוּלַת בַּת־צִיּוֹן כִּי־גָדוֹל כַּיָּם שִׁבְרֵךְ מִי יִרְפָּא־לָךְ ׃ ס
lxx: Μήμ. Γί μαρτυρήσω σοι ἡ τί ὁμοιώσω σοι, θύγατερ Ἰερουσαλήμ; τίς σώσει καὶ παρακαλέσει σε, παρθένος θύγατερ Σειών; ὅτι ἐμεγαλύνθη ποτήριον συντριβῆς σου· τίς ἰάσεταί σε;
vulg: MEM cui conparabo te vel cui adsimilabo te filia Hierusalem cui exaequabo te et consolabor te virgo filia Sion magna enim velut mare contritio tua quis medebitur tui
clem: Mem Cui comparabo te, vel cui assimilabo te, filia Jerusalem? cui exquabo te, et consolabor te, virgo, filia Sion? magna est enim velut mare contritio tua: quis medebitur tui?
kjv: What thing shall I take to witness for thee? what thing shall I liken to thee, O daughter of Jerusalem? what shall I equal to thee, that I may comfort thee, O virgin daughter of Zion? for thy breach is great like the sea: who can heal thee?

wlc: נְבִיאַיִךְ חָזוּ לָךְ שָׁוְא וְתָפֵל וְלֹא־גִלּוּ עַל־עֲוֹנֵךְ לְהָשִׁיב שְׁבִיתֵךְ וַיֶּחֱזוּ לָךְ מַשְׂאוֹת שָׁוְא וּמַדּוּחִים ׃ ס
lxx: Nοόν. ΓΙροφῆταί σου εἰδοσάν σοι μάταια καὶ ἀφροσύνην, καὶ οὐκ ἀπεκάλυψαν ἐπὶ τὴν ἀδικίαν σου τοῦ ἐπιστρέψαι αἰχμαλωσίαν σου, καὶ εἶδοσάν σοι λήμματα μάταια καὶ ἐξώσματα.
vulg: NUN prophetae tui viderunt tibi falsa et stulta nec aperiebant iniquitatem tuam ut te ad paenitentiam provocarent viderunt autem tibi adsumptiones falsas et eiectiones
clem: Nun Prophet tui viderunt tibi falsa et stulta; nec aperiebant iniquitatem tuam, ut te ad pnitentiam provocarent; viderunt autem tibi assumptiones falsas, et ejectiones.
kjv: Thy prophets have seen vain and foolish things for thee: and they have not discovered thine iniquity, to turn away thy captivity; but have seen for thee false burdens and causes of banishment.

wlc: סָפְקוּ עָלַיִךְ כַּפַּיִם כָּל־עֹבְרֵי דֶרֶךְ שָׁרְקוּ וַיָּנִעוּ רֹאשָׁם עַל־בַּת יְרוּשָׁלִָם הֲזֹאת הָעִיר שֶׁיֹּאמְרוּ כְּלִילַת יֹפִי מָשׂוֹשׂ לְכָל־הָאָרֶץ ׃ ס
lxx: Σάμχ Ἐκρότησαν ἐπὶ σέ χεῖρας πάντες οἱ παραπορευόμενοι ὁδόν, ἐσύρισαν καὶ ἐκίνησαν τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὴν θυγατέρα Ἰερουσαλήμ· αὕτη ἡ πόλις, ἐροῦσιν, στέφανος εὐφροσύνης πάσης τῆς γῆς.
vulg: SAMECH plauserunt super te manibus omnes transeuntes per viam sibilaverunt et moverunt caput suum super filiam Hierusalem haecine est urbs dicentes perfecti decoris gaudium universae terrae
clem: Samech Plauserunt super te manibus omnes transeuntes per viam; sibilaverunt et moverunt caput suum super filiam Jerusalem: Hccine est urbs, dicentes, perfecti decoris, gaudium univers terr?
kjv: All that pass by clap their hands at thee; they hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, Is this the city that men call The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?

wlc: פָּצוּ עָלַיִךְ פִּיהֶם כָּל־אוֹיְבַיִךְ שָׁרְקוּ וַיַּחַרְקוּ־שֵׁן אָמְרוּ בִּלָּעְנוּ אַךְ זֶה הַיּוֹם שֶׁקִּוִּינֻהוּ מָצָאנוּ רָאִינוּ ׃ ס
lxx: Ἄιν. Διήνοιξαν ἐπὶ σέ στόμα αὐτῶν πάντες οἱ ἐχθροί σου, ἐσύρισαν καὶ ἔβρυξαν ὀδόντας, καὶ εἶπαν Κατεπίομεν αὐτήν· πλὴν αὕτη ἡ ἡμέρα ἣν προσεδοκῶμεν, είρομεν αὐτήν, ἴδομεν.
vulg: FE aperuerunt super te os suum omnes inimici tui sibilaverunt et fremuerunt dentibus dixerunt devoravimus en ista est dies quam expectabamus invenimus vidimus
clem: Phe Aperuerunt super te os suum omnes inimici tui: sibilaverunt, et fremuerunt dentibus, et dixerunt: Devorabimus: en ista est dies quam exspectabamus; invenimus, vidimus.
kjv: All thine enemies have opened their mouth against thee: they hiss and gnash the teeth: they say, We have swallowed her up: certainly this is the day that we looked for; we have found, we have seen it.

wlc: עָשָׂה יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר זָמָם בִּצַּע אֶמְרָתוֹ אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה מִימֵי־קֶדֶם הָרַס וְלֹא חָמָל וַיְשַׂמַּח עָלַיִךְ אוֹיֵב הֵרִים קֶרֶן צָרָיִךְ ׃ ס
lxx: Φή. Ἐποίησεν Κύριος ἃ ἐνεθυμήθη, συνετέλεσεν ὀήματα αὐτοῦ, ἃ ἐνετείλατο ἐξ ἡμερῶν ἀρχαίων· καθεῖλεν καὶ οὐκ ἐφείσατο, καὶ ηὔφρανεν ἐπὶ σέ ἐχθρόν, ὕψωσεν κέρας θλίλκδοντός σε.
vulg: AIN fecit Dominus quae cogitavit conplevit sermonem suum quem praeceperat a diebus antiquis destruxit et non pepercit et laetificavit super te inimicum et exaltavit cornu hostium tuorum
clem: Ain Fecit Dominus qu cogitavit; complevit sermonem suum, quem prceperat a diebus antiquis: destruxit, et non pepercit, et ltificavit super te inimicum, et exaltavit cornu hostium tuorum.
kjv: The Lord hath done that which he had devised; he hath fulfilled his word that he had commanded in the days of old: he hath thrown down, and hath not pitied: and he hath caused thine enemy to rejoice over thee, he hath set up the horn of thine adversaries.

wlc: צָעַק לִבָּם אֶל־אֲדֹנָי חוֹמַת בַּת־צִיּוֹן הוֹרִידִי כַנַּחַל דִּמְעָה יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה אַל־תִּתְּנִי פוּגַת לָךְ אַל־תִּדֹּם בַּת־עֵינֵךְ ׃ ס
lxx: Τιαδή. Ἐβόησεν καρδία αὐτῶν πρὸς Κύριον Γείχη Σειών, καταγάγετε ὡς χειμάρρους δάκρυα ἡμέρας καὶ υυκτός· μὴ δῷς ἔκνηψιν σεαυτῇ, μὴ σιωπήσαιτο, θυγάτηρ, ὁ ὀφθαλμός σου.
vulg: SADE clamavit cor eorum ad Dominum super muros filiae Sion deduc quasi torrentem lacrimas per diem et per noctem non des requiem tibi neque taceat pupilla oculi tui
clem: Sade Clamavit cor eorum ad Dominum super muros fili Sion: Deduc quasi torrentem lacrimas per diem et noctem; non des requiem tibi, neque taceat pupilla oculi tui.
kjv: Their heart cried unto the Lord, O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night: give thyself no rest; let not the apple of thine eye cease.

wlc: קוּמִי רֹנִּי בַלַּיִל לְרֹאשׁ אַשְׁמֻרוֹת שִׁפְכִי כַמַּיִם לִבֵּךְ נֹכַח פְּנֵי אֲדֹנָי שְׂאִי אֵלָיו כַּפַּיִךְ עַל־נֶפֶשׁ עוֹלָלַיִךְ הָעֲטוּפִים בְּרָעָב בְּרֹאשׁ כָּל־חוּצוֹת ׃ ס
lxx: Κώφ. Ἀνάστα ἀγαλλίασαι ἐν νυκτὶ εἰς ἀρχὰς φυλακῆς σου, ἕκχεον ὡς ὕδωρ καρδίαν σου ἀπέναντι προσώπου Κυρίου, ἄρον πρὸς αὐτὸν χεῖράς σου περὶ ψυχῆς νηπίων τῶν ἐκλυομένων λιμῷ ἐπʼ ἀρχῆς πασῶν ἐξόδων.
vulg: COPH consurge lauda in nocte in principio vigiliarum effunde sicut aqua cor tuum ante conspectum Domini leva ad eum manus tuas pro anima parvulorum tuorum qui defecerunt in fame in capite omnium conpetorum
clem: Coph Consurge, lauda in nocte, in principio vigiliarum; effunde sicut aquam cor tuum ante conspectum Domini: leva ad eum manus tuas pro anima parvulorum tuorum, qui defecerunt in fame in capite omnium compitorum.
kjv: Arise, cry out in the night: in the beginning of the watches pour out thine heart like water before the face of the Lord: lift up thy hands toward him for the life of thy young children, that faint for hunger in the top of every street.

wlc: רְאֵה יְהוָה וְהַבִּיטָה לְמִי עוֹלַלְתָּ כֹּה אִם־תֹּאכַלְנָה נָשִׁים פִּרְיָם עֹלֲלֵי טִפֻּחִים אִם־יֵהָרֵג בְּמִקְדַּשׁ אֲדֹנָי כֹּהֵן וְנָבִיא ׃ ס
lxx: 'Ρήχς. Ἴδε, Κύριε, καὶ ἐπίcβλεψον τίνι ἐπεφύλλισας οὕτως εἰ φάγονται γυναίκες καρπὸν κοιλίας αὐτῶν ἐπιφυλλίδα ἐποίησεν μάγειρος· φονευθήσονται νήπιι θηλάζοντα μαστούς; ἀποκτενεῖς ἐν ἁγιάσματι Κυρίου ἱερέα καὶ προφήτην;
vulg: RES vide Domine et considera quem vindemiaveris ita ergone comedent mulieres fructum suum parvulos ad mensuram palmae si occidetur in sanctuario Domini sacerdos et propheta
clem: Res Vide, Domine, et considera quem vindemiaveris ita. Ergone comedent mulieres fructum suum, parvulos ad mensuram palm? si occiditur in sanctuario Domini sacerdos et propheta?
kjv: Behold, O Lord, and consider to whom thou hast done this. Shall the women eat their fruit, and children of a span long? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord?

wlc: שָׁכְבוּ לָאָרֶץ חוּצוֹת נַעַר וְזָקֵן בְּתוּלֹתַי וּבַחוּרַי נָפְלוּ בֶחָרֶב הָרַגְתָּ בְּיוֹם אַפֶּךָ טָבַחְתָּ לֹא חָמָלְתָּ ׃ ס
lxx: Κσέν. Ἐκοιμήθησαν εἰς τὴν ἔξοδον παιδάριον καὶ πρεσβύτης· παρθένοι μου καὶ νεανίσκοι μου ἐπορεύθησαν ἐν αίχμαλωσία· ἐν όομφαίᾳ καὶ ἐν λιμῷ ἀπέκτεινας, ἐν ἡμἐρᾳ ὀργῆς σου ἐμαγείρευσας, οὐκ ἐφείσω.
vulg: SEN iacuerunt in terra foris puer et senex virgines meae et iuvenes mei ceciderunt in gladio interfecisti in die furoris tui percussisti nec misertus es
clem: Sin Jacuerunt in terra foris puer et senex; virgines me et juvenes mei ceciderunt in gladio: interfecisti in die furoris tui, percussisti, nec misertus es.
kjv: The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets: my virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword; thou hast slain them in the day of thine anger; thou hast killed, and not pitied.

wlc: תִּקְרָא כְיוֹם מוֹעֵד מְגוּרַי מִסָּבִיב וְלֹא הָיָה בְּיוֹם אַף־יְהוָה פָּלִיט וְשָׂרִיד אֲשֶׁר־טִפַּחְתִּי וְרִבִּיתִי אֹיְבִי כִלָּם ׃ פ
lxx: Φαύ. Ἐκάλεσεν ἡμέραν ἑορτῆς παροικίας μου κυκλόθεν, καὶ οὐκ ἐγένοντο ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἀργῆς Κυρίου ἀνασωζόμενος καὶ καταλελειμμένος, ὁὡς ἐπεκράτησα καὶ ἐπλήθυνα ἐχθρούς μου πάντας.
vulg: THAU vocasti quasi ad diem sollemnem qui terrerent me de circuitu et non fuit in die furoris Domini qui effugeret et relinqueretur quos educavi et enutrivi inimicus meus consumpsit eos
clem: Thau Vocasti quasi ad diem solemnem, qui terrerent me de circuitu; et non fuit in die furoris Domini qui effugeret, et relinqueretur: quos educavi et enutrivi, inimicus meus consumpsit eos.]
kjv: Thou hast called as in a solemn day my terrors round about, so that in the day of the Lord's anger none escaped nor remained: those that I have swaddled and brought up hath mine enemy consumed.

wlc: אֲנִי הַגֶּבֶר רָאָה עֳנִי בְּשֵׁבֶט עֶבְרָתוֹ ׃
lxx: Ἅλεφ. Ἐγὼ ἀνήρ ὁ βλέπων πτωχείαν, ἐν ῥάβδῳ θυμοῦ αὐτοῦ ἐπʼ ἐμέ
vulg: ALEPH ego vir videns paupertatem meam in virga indignationis eius
clem: [ Aleph Ego vir videns paupertatem meam in virga indignationis ejus.
kjv: I Am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.

wlc: אוֹתִי נָהַג וַיֹּלַךְ חֹשֶׁךְ וְלֹא־אוֹר ׃
lxx: παρέλαβέν με καὶ ἀπήγαγεν εἰς σκότος καὶ οὐ φῶς.
vulg: ALEPH me minavit et adduxit in tenebris et non in lucem
clem: Aleph Me minavit, et adduxit in tenebras, et non in lucem.
kjv: He hath led me, and brought me into darkness, but not into light.

wlc: אַךְ בִּי יָשֻׁב יַהֲפֹךְ יָדוֹ כָּל־הַיּוֹם ׃ ס
lxx: πλὴν ἐν ἐμοὶ ἐπέστρεψεν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν,
vulg: ALEPH tantum in me vertit et convertit manum suam tota die
clem: Aleph Tantum in me vertit et convertit manum suam tota die.
kjv: Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand against me all the day.

wlc: בִּלָּה בְשָׂרִי וְעוֹרִי שִׁבַּר עַצְמוֹתָי ׃
lxx: ἐπαλαίωσεν σάρκα μου καὶ δέρμα μου, ὀστέα μου συνέτριψεν.
vulg: BETH vetustam fecit pellem meam et carnem meam contrivit ossa mea
clem: Beth Vetustam fecit pellem meam et carnem meam; contrivit ossa mea.
kjv: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.

wlc: בָּנָה עָלַי וַיַּקַּף רֹאשׁ וּתְלָאָה ׃
lxx: Βή. ʼΑνκοδόμησεν κατʼ ἐμοῦ, καὶ ἐκύκλωσεν κεφαλὴν μου καὶ ἐμόχθησεν,
vulg: BETH aedificavit in gyro meo et circumdedit me felle et labore
clem: Beth dificavit in gyro meo, et circumdedit me felle et labore.
kjv: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.

wlc: בְּמַחֲשַׁכִּים הוֹשִׁיבַנִי כְּמֵתֵי עוֹלָם ׃ ס
lxx: ἐυ σκοτινοῖς ἐκάθισέν με ὠς νεκροὺς αἰῶνος,
vulg: BETH in tenebrosis conlocavit me quasi mortuos sempiternos
clem: Beth In tenebrosis collocavit me, quasi mortuos sempiternos.
kjv: He hath set me in dark places, as they that be dead of old.

wlc: גָּדַר בַּעֲדִי וְלֹא אֵצֵא הִכְבִּיד נְחָשְׁתִּי ׃
lxx: ἀνῳκοδόμησεν κατʼ ἐμοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἐξελεύσομαι, ἐβάρυνεν χαλκόν μου.
vulg: GIMEL circumaedificavit adversum me ut non egrediar adgravavit conpedem meam
clem: Ghimel Circumdificavit adversum me, ut non egrediar; aggravavit compedem meum.
kjv: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.

wlc: גַּם כִּי אֶזְעַק וַאֲשַׁוֵּעַ שָׂתַם תְּפִלָּתִי ׃
lxx: Γμελ. Καί γε κεκράξομαι καὶ βοήσω, ἀπέφραξεν προσευχήν μου.
vulg: GIMEL sed et cum clamavero et rogavero exclusit orationem meam
clem: Ghimel Sed et cum clamavero, et rogavero, exclusit orationem meam.
kjv: Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.

wlc: גָּדַר דְּרָכַי בְּגָזִית נְתִיבֹתַי עִוָּה ׃
lxx: Δάλεθ. ’Ανῳκοδόμησεν ὁⁱούς μου, ἐνέφραξεν τρίβους μου, ἐτάραξεν
vulg: GIMEL conclusit vias meas lapidibus quadris semitas meas subvertit
clem: Ghimel Conclusit vias meas lapidibus quadris; semitas meas subvertit.
kjv: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.

wlc: ס דֹּב אֹרֵב הוּא לִי אַרְיֵה בְּמִסְתָּרִים ׃
lxx: ἄρκος ἐνεδρεύουσα, αὐτός μοι λέων ἐν κρυφαίοις·
vulg: DELETH ursus insidians factus est mihi leo in absconditis
clem: Daleth Ursus insidians factus est mihi, leo in absconditis.
kjv: He was unto me as a bear lying in wait, and as a lion in secret places.

wlc: דְּרָכַי סוֹרֵר וַיְפַשְּׁחֵנִי שָׂמַנִי שֹׁמֵם ׃
lxx: κατεδίωξεν ἀφεστηκότα καὶ κατέπαυσέν με, ἔθετό με ἠφανισμένην.
vulg: DELETH semitas meas subvertit et confregit me posuit me desolatam
clem: Daleth Semitas meas subvertit, et confregit me; posuit me desolatam.
kjv: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.

wlc: דָּרַךְ קַשְׁתּוֹ וַיַּצִּיבֵנִי כַּמַּטָּרָא לַחֵץ ׃ ס
lxx: Ἥ Ἐνέτεινεν τόξον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐστήλωσέν με ὡς σκοπὸν εἰς βέλος,
vulg: DELETH tetendit arcum suum et posuit me quasi signum ad sagittam
clem: Daleth Tetendit arcum suum, et posuit me quasi signum ad sagittam.
kjv: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

wlc: הֵבִיא בְּכִלְיוֹתָי בְּנֵי אַשְׁפָּתוֹ ׃
lxx: εἰσήγαγεν τοῖς νεφροῖς μου ἰοὺς φαρέτρας αὐτοῦ·
vulg: HE misit in renibus meis filias faretrae suae
clem: He Misit in renibus meis filias pharetr su.
kjv: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.

wlc: הָיִיתִי שְּׂחֹק לְכָל־עַמִּי נְגִינָתָם כָּל־הַיּוֹם ׃
lxx: ἐγενήθην γέλως παντὶ λαῷ μου, ψαλμὸς αὐτῶν ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν.
vulg: HE factus sum in derisu omni populo meo canticum eorum tota die
clem: He Factus sum in derisum omni populo meo, canticum eorum tota die.
kjv: I was a derision to all my people; and their song all the day.

wlc: הִשְׂבִּיעַנִי בַמְּרוֹרִים הִרְוַנִי לַעֲנָה ׃
lxx: Οὐαύ. ’Ἐχόρτασέν με πικρίας, ἐμέθυσέν με χολῆς,
vulg: HE replevit me amaritudinibus inebriavit me absinthio
clem: He Replevit me amaritudinibus; inebriavit me absinthio.
kjv: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood.

wlc: ס וַיַּגְרֵס בֶּחָצָץ שִׁנָּי הִכְפִּישַׁנִי בָּאֵפֶר ׃
lxx: καὶ ἐξέβαλεν ψήφῳ ὀδόντας μου, ἐψώμισέν με σποδόν·
vulg: VAV et fregit ad numerum dentes meos cibavit me cinere
clem: Vau Et fregit ad numerum dentes meos; cibavit me cinere.
kjv: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.

wlc: וַתִּזְנַח מִשָּׁלוֹם נַפְשִׁי נָשִׁיתִי טוֹבָה ׃
lxx: καὶ ἀπώσατο ἐξ εἰρήνης ψυχὴν μου, ἐπελαθόμην ἀγαθά,
vulg: VAV et repulsa est anima mea oblitus sum bonorum
clem: Vau Et repulsa est a pace anima mea; oblitus sum bonorum.
kjv: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity.

wlc: וָאֹמַר אָבַד נִצְחִי וְתוֹחַלְתִּי מֵיְהוָה ׃ ס
lxx: καὶ ἀπώλετο νῖκός μου καὶ ἡ ἐλπίς μου ἀπὸ Κυρίου.
vulg: VAV et dixi periit finis meus et spes mea a Domino
clem: Vau Et dixi: Periit finis meus, et spes mea a Domino.
kjv: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the Lord:

wlc: זְכָר־עָנְיִי וּמְרוּדִי לַעֲנָה וָרֹאשׁ ׃
lxx: Zάι. ʼΚἘμνήσθην ἀπὸ πτωχείας μου καὶ ἐκ διωγμοῦ,
vulg: ZAI recordare paupertatis et transgressionis meae absinthii et fellis
clem: Zain Recordare paupertatis, et transgressionis me, absinthii et fellis.
kjv: Remembering mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.

wlc: זָכוֹר תִּזְכּוֹר וְתָשִׁיחַ עָלַי נַפְשִׁי ׃
lxx: πικρία καὶ χολὴ μου μνησθήσεται, καὶ καταδολεσχήσει ἐπʼ ἐμὲ ἡ ψυχή μου·
vulg: ZAI memoria memor ero et tabescet in me anima mea
clem: Zain Memoria memor ero, et tabescet in me anima mea.
kjv: My soul hath them still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.

wlc: זֹאת אָשִׁיב אֶל־לִבִּי עַל־כֵּן אוֹחִיל ׃ ס
lxx: ταύτην τάξω εἰς τὴν καρδίαν μου, διὰ τοῦτο ὑπομενῶ.
vulg: ZAI hoc recolens in corde meo ideo sperabo
clem: Zain Hc recolens in corde meo, ideo sperabo.
kjv: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.

wlc: חַסְדֵי יְהוָה כִּי לֹא־תָמְנוּ כִּי לֹא־כָלוּ רַחֲמָיו ׃
vulg: HETH misericordiae Domini quia non sumus consumpti quia non defecerunt miserationes eius
clem: Heth Misericordi Domini, quia non sumus consumpti; quia non defecerunt miserationes ejus.
kjv: It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.

wlc: חֲדָשִׁים לַבְּקָרִים רַבָּה אֱמוּנָתֶךָ ׃
vulg: HETH novae diluculo multa est fides tua
clem: Heth Novi diluculo, multa est fides tua.
kjv: They are new every morning: great is thy faithfulness.

wlc: חֶלְקִי יְהוָה אָמְרָה נַפְשִׁי עַל־כֵּן אוֹחִיל לוֹ ׃ ס
vulg: HETH pars mea Dominus dixit anima mea propterea expectabo eum
clem: Heth Pars mea Dominus, dixit anima mea; propterea exspectabo eum.
kjv: The Lord is my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.

wlc: טוֹב יְהוָה לְקוָֹו לְנֶפֶשׁ תִּדְרְשֶׁנּוּ ׃
lxx: Ἥθ. Ἀγαθὸς Κύριος τοῖς ὑπομένουσιν αὐτόν, ψυχῇ ἡ ζητήσει αὐτὸν ἀγαθόν·
vulg: TETH bonus est Dominus sperantibus in eum animae quaerenti illum
clem: Teth Bonus est Dominus sperantibus in eum, anim qurenti illum.
kjv: The Lord is good unto them that wait for him, to the soul that seeketh him.

wlc: טוֹב וְיָחִיל וְדוּמָם לִתְשׁוּעַת יְהוָה ׃
lxx: καὶ ὑπομενεῖ καὶ ἡσυχάσει εἰς τὸ σωτήριον Κυρίου.
vulg: TETH bonum est praestolari cum silentio salutare Domini
clem: Teth Bonum est prstolari cum silentio salutare Dei.
kjv: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the Lord.

wlc: טוֹב לַגֶּבֶר כִּי־יִשָּׂא עֹל בִּנְעוּרָיו ׃
lxx: Tήθ. Ἀγαθὸν ἀνδρὶ ὅταν ἄρῃ ζυγὸν ἐν νεότητι αὐτοῦ,
vulg: TETH bonum est viro cum portaverit iugum ab adulescentia sua
clem: Teth Bonum est viro cum portaverit jugum ab adolescentia sua.
kjv: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

wlc: ס יֵשֵׁב בָּדָד וְיִדֹּם כִּי נָטַל עָלָיו ׃
lxx: καθήσεται κατὰ μόνας καὶ σιωπήσεται, ὅτι ἤρεν ἐφʼ ἑαυτῷ.
vulg: IOTH sedebit solitarius et tacebit quia levavit super se
clem: Jod Sedebit solitarius, et tacebit, quia levavit super se.
kjv: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne it upon him.

wlc: יִתֵּן בֶּעָפָר פִּיהוּ אוּלַי יֵשׁ תִּקְוָה ׃
vulg: IOTH ponet in pulvere os suum si forte sit spes
clem: Jod Ponet in pulvere os suum, si forte sit spes.
kjv: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.

wlc: יִתֵּן לְמַכֵּהוּ לֶחִי יִשְׂבַּע בְּחֶרְפָּה ׃
lxx: Ἰώδ. Δώσει τῷ παίοντι αὐτὸν σιαγόνα, χορτασθήσεται ὀνειδισμῶν,
vulg: IOTH dabit percutienti se maxillam saturabitur obprobriis
clem: Jod Dabit percutienti se maxillam: saturabitur opprobriis.
kjv: He giveth his cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.

wlc: ס כִּי לֹא יִזְנַח לְעוֹלָם אֲדֹנָי ׃
lxx: ὅτι οὐκ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ἀπώσεται Κύριος.
vulg: CAPH quia non repellet in sempiternum Dominus
clem: Caph Quia non repellet in sempiternum Dominus.
kjv: For the Lord will not cast off for ever:

wlc: כִּי אִם־הוֹגָה וְרִחַם כְּרֹב חַסְדּוֹ ׃
lxx: Xάφ. Ὅτι ὁ ταπεινώσας οἰκτειρήσει καὶ κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος τοῦ ἐλέους αὐτοῦ·
vulg: CAPH quia si abiecit et miserebitur secundum multitudinem misericordiarum suarum
clem: Caph Quia si abjecit, et miserebitur, secundum multitudinem misericordiarum suarum.
kjv: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.

wlc: כִּי לֹא עִנָּה מִלִּבּוֹ וַיַּגֶּה בְּנֵי־אִישׁ ׃ ס
lxx: οὐκ ἀπεκρίθη ἀπὸ καρδίας αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐταπείνωσεν υἱοὺς ἀνδρός.
vulg: CAPH non enim humiliavit ex corde suo et abiecit filios hominis
clem: Caph Non enim humiliavit ex corde suo et abjecit filios hominum.
kjv: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.

wlc: לְדַכֵּא תַּחַת רַגְלָיו כֹּל אֲסִירֵי אָרֶץ ׃
lxx: Λαβδ. Γοῦ ταπεινῶσαι ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ πάντας δεσμίους γῆς,
vulg: LAMED ut contereret sub pedibus suis omnes vinctos terrae
clem: Lamed Ut conteret sub pedibus suis omnes vinctos terr.
kjv: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth.

wlc: לְהַטּוֹת מִשְׁפַּט־גָּבֶר נֶגֶד פְּנֵי עֶלְיוֹן ׃
lxx: τοῦ ἐκκλῖναι κρίσιν ἀνδρὸς κατέναντι προσώπου Γψίστου,
vulg: LAMED ut declinaret iudicium viri in conspectu vultus Altissimi
clem: Lamed Ut declinaret judicium viri in conspectu vultus Altissimi.
kjv: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High,

wlc: לְעַוֵּת אָדָם בְּרִיבוֹ אֲדֹנָי לֹא רָאָה ׃ ס
lxx: καταδικάσαι ἄνθρωπον ἐν τῷ κρίνεσθαι αὐτόν, Κύριος οὐκ εἶπεν.
vulg: LAMED ut perverteret hominem in iudicio suo Dominus ignoravit
clem: Lamed Ut perverteret hominem in judicio suo; Dominus ignoravit.
kjv: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.

wlc: מִי זֶה אָמַר וַתֶּהִי אֲדֹנָי לֹא צִוָּה ׃
lxx: τίς οὕτως εἶπεν, καὶ ἐγενήθη; Κύριος οὐκ ἐνετείλατο·
vulg: MEM quis est iste qui dixit ut fieret Domino non iubente
clem: Mem Quis est iste qui dixit ut fieret, Domino non jubente?
kjv: Who is he that saith, and it cometh to pass, when the Lord commandeth it not?

wlc: מִפִּי עֶלְיוֹן לֹא תֵצֵא הָרָעוֹת וְהַטּוֹב ׃
lxx: ἐκ στόματος Ὑψίστου οὐκ ἐξελεύσεται τὰ κακὰ καὶ τὸ ἀγαθόν.
vulg: MEM ex ore Altissimi non egredientur nec mala nec bona
clem: Mem Ex ore Altissimi non egredientur nec mala nec bona?
kjv: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?

wlc: מַה־יִּתְאוֹנֵן אָדָם חָי גֶּבֶר עַל־חֶטְאוֹ ׃ ס
lxx: Μήμ. Τί γογγύσῃ ἄνθρωπος ζῶν ἀνὴρ περὶ τῆς ἁμαρτίας αὐτοῦ;
vulg: MEM quid murmuravit homo vivens vir pro peccatis suis
clem: Mem Quid murmuravit homo vivens, vir pro peccatis suis?
kjv: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?

wlc: נַחְפְּשָׂה דְרָכֵינוּ וְנַחְקֹרָה וְנָשׁוּבָה עַד־יְהוָה ׃
lxx: Nούν. Ἐξηρευνήθη ἡ ὁδὸς ἡμῶν καὶ ἠτάσθη, καὶ ἐπιστρέψωμεν ἕως Κυρίου·
vulg: NUN scrutemur vias nostras et quaeramus et revertamur ad Dominum
clem: Nun Scrutemur vias nostras, et quramus, et revertamur ad Dominum.
kjv: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the Lord.

wlc: נִשָּׂא לְבָבֵנוּ אֶל־כַּפָּיִם אֶל־אֵל בַּשָּׁמָיִם ׃
lxx: ἀναλάβωμεν καρδίας ἡμῶν ἐπὶ χειρῶν πρὸς Γψηλὸν ἐν οὐρανῷ·
vulg: NUN levemus corda nostra cum manibus ad Dominum in caelos
clem: Nun Levemus corda nostra cum manibus ad Dominum in clos.
kjv: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens.

wlc: נַחְנוּ פָשַׁעְנוּ וּמָרִינוּ אַתָּה לֹא סָלָחְתָּ ׃ ס
lxx: ἡμαρτήσαμεν, ἠσεβήσαμεν, καὶ οὐχ ἱλάσθης.
vulg: NUN nos inique egimus et ad iracundiam provocavimus idcirco tu inexorabilis es
clem: Nun Nos inique egimus, et ad iracundiam provocavimus; idcirco tu inexorabilis es.
kjv: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.

wlc: סַכֹּתָה בָאַף וַתִּרְדְּפֵנוּ הָרַגְתָּ לֹא חָמָלְתָּ ׃
lxx: Σάμχ. Ἐπεσκέπασας ἐν θυμῷ καὶ ἀπεδίωξας ἡμᾶς, ἀπέκτεινας, οὐκ ἐφείσω.
vulg: SAMECH operuisti in furore et percussisti nos occidisti nec pepercisti
clem: Samech Operuisti in furore, et percussisti nos; occidisti, nec pepercisti.
kjv: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.

wlc: סַכּוֹתָה בֶעָנָן לָךְ מֵעֲבוֹר תְּפִלָּה ׃
lxx: ἐπεσκέπασας νεφέλην σεαυτῷ εἰνεκεν προσευχῆς,
vulg: SAMECH opposuisti nubem tibi ne transeat oratio
clem: Samech Opposuisti nubem tibi, ne transeat oratio.
kjv: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that our prayer should not pass through.

wlc: סְחִי וּמָאוֹס תְּשִׂימֵנוּ בְּקֶרֶב הָעַמִּים ׃ ס
lxx: καμμύσαι με καὶ ἀπαωσθῆναι.
vulg: SAMECH eradicationem et abiectionem posuisti me in medio populorum
clem: Samech Eradicationem et abjectionem posuisti me in medio populorum.
kjv: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.

wlc: פָּצוּ עָלֵינוּ פִּיהֶם כָּל־אֹיְבֵינוּ ׃
lxx: Ἄιν. Ἕθηκας ἡμᾶς ἐν μέσῳ τῶν λαῶν, ⁴⁶ διήνοιξαν ἐφʼ ἡμᾶς τὸ στόμα αὐτῶν πάντες οἱ ἐχθροὶ ἡμῶν.
vulg: FE aperuerunt super nos os suum omnes inimici
clem: Phe Aperuerunt super nos os suum omnes inimici.
kjv: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.

wlc: פַּחַד וָפַחַת הָיָה לָנוּ הַשֵּׁאת וְהַשָּׁבֶר ׃
lxx: φόβος καὶ θυμὸς ἐγενήθη ἡμῖν, ἔπαρσις καὶ συντριβή·
vulg: FE formido et laqueus facta est nobis vaticinatio et contritio
clem: Phe Formido et laqueus facta est nobis vaticinatio, et contritio.
kjv: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.

wlc: פַּלְגֵי־מַיִם תֵּרַד עֵינִי עַל־שֶׁבֶר בַּת־עַמִּי ׃ ס
lxx: ἀφέσεις ὑδάτων κατάξει ὁ ὀφθαλμός μου ἐπὶ τὸ σύντριμμα τῆς θυγατρὸς τοῦ λαοῦ μου.
vulg: FE divisiones aquarum deduxit oculus meus in contritione filiae populi mei
clem: Phe Divisiones aquarum deduxit oculus meus, in contritione fili populi mei.
kjv: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

wlc: עֵינִי נִגְּרָה וְלֹא תִדְמֶה מֵאֵין הֲפֻגוֹת ׃
lxx: Φή. Ὁ ὀφθαλμός μου κατεπόθη, καὶ οὐ σιγήσομαι τοῦ μὴ εἰνιι ἕκνηψιν,
vulg: AIN oculus meus adflictus est nec tacuit eo quod non esset requies
clem: Ain Oculus meus afflictus est, nec tacuit, eo quod non esset requies.
kjv: Mine eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission.

wlc: עַד־יַשְׁקִיף וְיֵרֶא יְהוָה מִשָּׁמָיִם ׃
lxx: ἔως οὗ διακύψῃ καὶ ἴδῃ Κύριος ἐξ οὐρανοῦ.
vulg: AIN donec respiceret et videret Dominus de caelis
clem: Ain Donec respiceret et videret Dominus de clis.
kjv: Till the Lord look down, and behold from heaven.

wlc: עֵינִי עוֹלְלָה לְנַפְשִׁי מִכֹּל בְּנוֹת עִירִי ׃ ס
lxx: ὀφθαλμός μου ἐπιφυλλιεῖ ἐπὶ τὴν ψυχὴν μου παρὰ πάσας θυγατέρας πόλεαως.
vulg: AIN oculus meus depraedatus est animam meam in cunctis filiabus urbis meae
clem: Ain Oculus meus deprdatus est animam meam in cunctis filiabus urbis me.
kjv: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city.

wlc: צוֹד צָדוּנִי כַּצִּפּוֹר אֹיְבַי חִנָּם ׃
lxx: Τιαδή. ηρεύοντες ἐθήρευσάν με ὡς στρουθίον πάντες οἱ ἐχθροί μου δωρεάν,
vulg: SADE venatione ceperunt me quasi avem inimici mei gratis
clem: Sade Venatione ceperunt me quasi avem inimici mei gratis.
kjv: Mine enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.

wlc: צָמְתוּ בַבּוֹר חַיָּי וַיַּדּוּ־אֶבֶן בִּי ׃
lxx: ἐθανάτωσαν ἐν λάκκῳ ζωήν μου καὶ ἐπέθηκαν λίθον ἐπʼ ἐμοί.
vulg: SADE lapsa est in lacu vita mea et posuerunt lapidem super me
clem: Sade Lapsa est in lacum vita mea, et posuerunt lapidem super me.
kjv: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.

wlc: צָפוּ־מַיִם עַל־רֹאשִׁי אָמַרְתִּי נִגְזָרְתִּי ׃
lxx: ὑπερεχύθη ὕδωρ ἐπὶ κεφαλὴν μου· εἶπα Ἀπῶσμαι.
vulg: SADE inundaverunt aquae super caput meum dixi perii
clem: Sade Inundaverunt aqu super caput meum; dixi: Perii.
kjv: Waters flowed over mine head; then I said, I am cut off.

wlc: ס קָרָאתִי שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה מִבּוֹר תַּחְתִּיּוֹת ׃
lxx: Κὼφ. Ἐπεκαλεσάμην τὸ ὄνομά σου, Κύριε, ἐκ λάκκου κατωτάτου,
vulg: COPH invocavi nomen tuum Domine de lacis novissimis
clem: Coph Invocavi nomen tuum, Domine, de lacu novissimo.
kjv: I called upon thy name, O Lord, out of the low dungeon.

wlc: קוֹלִי שָׁמָעְתָּ אַל־תַּעְלֵם אָזְנְךָ לְרַוְחָתִי לְשַׁוְעָתִי ׃
lxx: φωνήν μου ἤκουσας μὴ κρύψῃς τὰ ὥτά σου εἰς τὴν δέησίν μου·
vulg: COPH vocem meam audisti ne avertas aurem tuam a singultu meo et clamoribus
clem: Coph Vocem meam audisti; ne avertas aurem tuam a singultu meo et clamoribus.
kjv: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.

wlc: קָרַבְתָּ בְּיוֹם אֶקְרָאֶךָּ אָמַרְתָּ אַל־תִּירָא ׃ ס
lxx: εἰς τὴν βοήθειάν μου ἤγγισας, ἐν ῇ σε ἡμέρᾳ ἐπεκαλεσάμην εἶπάς μοι Μὴ φοβοῦ.
vulg: COPH adpropinquasti in die quando invocavi te dixisti ne timeas
clem: Coph Appropinquasti in die quando invocavi te; dixisti: Ne timeas.
kjv: Thou drewest near in the day that I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.

wlc: רַבְתָּ אֲדֹנָי רִיבֵי נַפְשִׁי גָּאַלְתָּ חַיָּי ׃
lxx: 'Ρήχς. Ἐδίκασας, Κύριε, τὰς δίκας τῆς ψυχῆς μου, ἐλυτρώσω τὴν ζωήν μου.
vulg: RES iudicasti Domine causam animae meae redemptor vitae meae
clem: Res Judicasti, Domine, causam anim me, redemptor vit me.
kjv: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.

wlc: רָאִיתָה יְהוָה עַוָּתָתִי שָׁפְטָה מִשְׁפָּטִי ׃
lxx: ἴδες, Κύριε, τὰς ταραχάς μου, ἔκρινας τὴν κρίσιν μου.
vulg: RES vidisti Domine iniquitatem adversum me iudica iudicium meum
clem: Res Vidisti, Domine, iniquitatem illorum adversum me: judica judicium meum.
kjv: O Lord, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.

wlc: רָאִיתָה כָּל־נִקְמָתָם כָּל־מַחְשְׁבֹתָם לִי ׃
lxx: τἶδες πᾶσαν τὴν ἐκδίκησιν αὐτῶν, εἰς πάντας διαλογισμοὺς αὐτῶν ἐν ἐμοί.
vulg: RES vidisti omnem furorem universas cogitationes eorum adversum me
clem: Res Vidisti omnem furorem, universas cogitationes eorum adversum me.
kjv: Thou hast seen all their vengeance and all their imaginations against me.

wlc: ס שָׁמַעְתָּ חֶרְפָּתָם יְהוָה כָּל־מַחְשְׁבֹתָם עָלָי ׃
lxx: Xσέν. Ἥκουσας τὸν ὀνειδισμὸν αὐτῶν, πάντας τοὺς διαλογισμοὺς αὐτῶν κατʼ ἐμοῦ,
vulg: SEN audisti obprobria eorum Domine omnes cogitationes eorum adversum me
clem: Sin Audisti opprobrium eorum, Domine, omnes cogitationes eorum adversum me.
kjv: Thou hast heard their reproach, O Lord, and all their imaginations against me;

wlc: שִׂפְתֵי קָמַי וְהֶגְיוֹנָם עָלַי כָּל־הַיּוֹם ׃
lxx: χείλη ἐπανισταμένων μοι καὶ μελέτας αὐτῶν κατʼ ἐμοῦ ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν.
vulg: SEN labia insurgentium mihi et meditationes eorum adversum me tota die
clem: Sin Labia insurgentium mihi, et meditationes eorum adversum me tota die.
kjv: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.

wlc: שִׁבְתָּם וְקִימָתָם הַבִּיטָה אֲנִי מַנְגִּינָתָם ׃ ס
lxx: καθέδραν αὐτῶν καὶ ἀνάκτησιν αὐτῶν. ἐπίβλεψον ἐπ ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτῶν,
vulg: SEN sessionem eorum et resurrectionem eorum vide ego sum psalmus eorum
clem: Sin Sessionem eorum et resurrectionem eorum vide; ego sum psalmus eorum.
kjv: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I am their musick.

wlc: תָּשִׁיב לָהֶם גְּמוּל יְהוָה כְּמַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵיהֶם ׃
lxx: Κποδώσεις αὐτοῖς ἀνταπόδομα, Κύριε, κατὰ τὰ ἔργα τῶν χειρῶν αὐτῶν.
vulg: THAU reddes eis vicem Domine iuxta opera manuum suarum
clem: Thau Redes eis vicem, Domine, juxta opera manuum suarum.
kjv: Render unto them a recompence, O Lord, according to the work of their hands.

wlc: תִּתֵּן לָהֶם מְגִנַּת־לֵב תַּאֲלָתְךָ לָהֶם ׃
lxx: Θαύ. Ἀποδώσεις αὐτοῖς ὑπερασπισμόν, καρδίας μόχθον.
vulg: THAU dabis eis scutum cordis laborem tuum
clem: Thau Dabis eis scutum cordis, laborem tuum.
kjv: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse unto them.

wlc: תִּרְדֹּף בְּאַף וְתַשְׁמִידֵם מִתַּחַת שְׁמֵי יְהוָה ׃ פ
lxx: σὺ αὐτοὺς καταδιώξεις ἐν ὀργῇ καὶ ἐξαναλώσεις αὐτοὺς ὑποκάτω τοῦ οὐρανοῦ, Κύριε.
vulg: THAU persequeris in furore et conteres eos sub caelis Domine
clem: Thau Persequeris in furore, et conteres eos sub clis, Domine.]
kjv: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the Lord.

wlc: אֵיכָה יוּעַם זָהָב יִשְׁנֶא הַכֶּתֶם הַטּוֹב תִּשְׁתַּפֵּכְנָה אַבְנֵי־קֹדֶשׁ בְּרֹאשׁ כָּל־חוּצוֹת ׃ ס
lxx: Ἅλεφ. Πῶς ἀμαυρωθήσεται χρυσίον, ἀλλοιωθήσεται τὸ ἀργύριον τὸ ἀγαθόν; ἐξεχύθησαν λίθοι ἅγιοι ἐπʼ ἀρχῆς πασῶν ἐξόδων.
vulg: ALEPH quomodo obscuratum est aurum mutatus est color optimus dispersi sunt lapides sanctuarii in capite omnium platearum
clem: [ Aleph Quomodo obscuratum est aurum, mutatus est color optimus! dispersi sunt lapides sanctuarii in capite omnium platearum!
kjv: How is the gold become dim! how is the most fine gold changed! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street.

wlc: בְּנֵי צִיּוֹן הַיְקָרִים הַמְסֻלָּאִים בַּפָּז אֵיכָה נֶחְשְׁבוּ לְנִבְלֵי־חֶרֶשׂ מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי יוֹצֵר ׃ ס
lxx: Bή. υἱοὶ Σειὼν οἱ τίμιοι οἱ ἐπηρμένοι ἐν χρυσίῳ, πῶς ἐλογίσθησαν εἰς ἄγγια ὀστράκινα, ἔργα χειρῶν κεραμέως
vulg: BETH filii Sion incliti et amicti auro primo quomodo reputati sunt in vasa testea opus manuum figuli
clem: Beth Filii Sion inclyti, et amicti auro primo: quomodo reputati sunt in vasa testea, opus manuum figuli!
kjv: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!

wlc: גַּם־תַּנִּין חָלְצוּ שַׁד הֵינִיקוּ גּוּרֵיהֶן בַּת־עַמִּי לְאַכְזָר כַּיְ עֵנִים בַּמִּדְבָּר ׃ ס
lxx: Γίμελ Καί γε δράκοντες ἐξέδυσαν μαστούς, ἐθήλασαν σκύμνοι αὐτῶν θυγατέρας λαοῦ μου εἰς ἀνίατον, ὡς στρουθίον ἐν ἐρήμῃ.
vulg: GIMEL sed et lamiae nudaverunt mammam lactaverunt catulos suos filia populi mei crudelis quasi strutio in deserto
clem: Ghimel Sed et lami nudaverunt mammam, lactaverunt catulos suos: filia populi mei crudelis quasi struthio in deserto.
kjv: Even the sea monsters draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: the daughter of my people is become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.

wlc: דָּבַק לְשׁוֹן יוֹנֵק אֶל־חִכּוֹ בַּצָּמָא עוֹלָלִים שָׁאֲלוּ לֶחֶם פֹּרֵשׂ אֵין לָהֶם ׃
lxx: Δάλεθ. Ἐκολλήθη ἡ γλῶσσα θηλάζοντος πρὸς τὸν φάρυγγα αὐτοῦ ἐν δίψει· νήπια ῆτησαν ἄρτον, ὁ διακλῶν οὐκ ἔστιν αὐτοῖς.
vulg: DELETH adhesit lingua lactantis ad palatum eius in siti parvuli petierunt panem et non erat qui frangeret eis
clem: Daleth Adhsit lingua lactentis ad palatum ejus in siti; parvuli petierunt panem, et non erat qui frangeret eis.
kjv: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst: the young children ask bread, and no man breaketh it unto them.

wlc: ס הָאֹכְלִים לְמַעֲדַנִּים נָשַׁמּוּ בַּחוּצוֹת הָאֱמֻנִים עֲלֵי תוֹלָע חִבְּקוּ אַשְׁפַּתּוֹת ׃ ס
lxx: Ἥ Οί ἔσθοντες τὰς τροφὰς ἠφανίσθησαν ἐν ταῖς ἐξόδοις, οἱ τιθηνούμενοι ἐπὶ κόκκῳ περιεβάλοντο κοπρίας.
vulg: HE qui vescebantur voluptuose interierunt in viis qui nutriebantur in croceis amplexati sunt stercora
clem: He Qui vescebantur voluptuose, interierunt in viis; qui nutriebantur in croceis, amplexati sunt stercora.
kjv: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.

wlc: וַיִּגְדַּל עֲוֹן בַּת־עַמִּי מֵחַטַּאת סְדֹם הַהֲפוּכָה כְמוֹ־רָגַע וְלֹא־חָלוּ בָהּ יָדָיִם ׃ ס
lxx: Οὐαό. Καὶ ἐμεγαλύνθη ἀνομία θυγατρὸς λαοῦ μου ὑπέρ ἀνομίας Σοδόμων, τῆς κατεστραμμένης ὥσπερ σπουδῇ, καὶ οὐκ ἐπόνεσαν ἐν αὐτῇ χεῖρας.
vulg: VAV et maior effecta est iniquitas filiae populi mei peccato Sodomorum quae subversa est in momento et non ceperunt in ea manus
clem: Vau Et major effecta est iniquitas fili populi mei peccato Sodomorum, qu subversa est in momento, et non ceperunt in ea manus.
kjv: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom, that was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands stayed on her.

wlc: זַכּוּ נְזִירֶיהָ מִשֶּׁלֶג צַחוּ מֵחָלָב אָדְמוּ עֶצֶם מִפְּנִינִים סַפִּיר גִּזְרָתָם ׃ ס
lxx: Ζάιν. Ἐκαθαριώθησαν Ναζειραῖοι αὐτῆς ὑπέρ χιόνα, ἔλαμψαν ὑπέρ γάλα, ἐπυρώθησαν ὑπέρ λίθους, σαπφείρου τὸ ἀπόσπασμα αὐτῶν.
vulg: ZAI candidiores nazarei eius nive nitidiores lacte rubicundiores ebore antiquo sapphyro pulchriores
clem: Zain Candidiores Nazari ejus nive, nitidiores lacte, rubicundiores ebore antiquo, sapphiro pulchriores.
kjv: Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk, they were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing was of sapphire:

wlc: חָשַׁךְ מִשְּׁחוֹר תָּאֳרָם לֹא נִכְּרוּ בַּחוּצוֹת צָפַד עוֹרָם עַל־עַצְמָם יָבֵשׁ הָיָה כָעֵץ ׃ ס
lxx: Ἥθ. Ἐσκότασεν ὑπέρ ἀσβόλην τὸ εἶδος αὐτῶν, οὐκ ἐπεγνώσθησαν ἐν ταῖς ἐξόδοις· ἐπάγη δέρμα αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὰ ὀστέα αὐτῶν, ἐξηράνθησαν, ἐγενήθησαν ὥσπερ ξύλον.
vulg: HETH denigrata est super carbones facies eorum et non sunt cogniti in plateis adhesit cutis eorum ossibus aruit et facta est quasi lignum
clem: Heth Denigrata est super carbones facies eorum et non sunt cogniti in plateis; adhsit cutis eorum ossibus: aruit, et facta est quasi lignum.
kjv: Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.

wlc: טוֹבִים הָיוּ חַלְלֵי־חֶרֶב מֵחַלְלֵי רָעָב שֶׁהֵם יָזוּבוּ מְדֻקָּרִים מִתְּנוּבֹת שָׂדָי ׃ ס
lxx: Τήθ. Καλοὶ ἦσαν οἱ τραυματίαι όομφαίας ἡ οἱ τραυματίαι λιμοῦ· ἐπορεύθησαν ἐκκεκεντημένοι ἀπὸ γενημάτων ἀγρῶν.
vulg: TETH melius fuit occisis gladio quam interfectis fame quoniam isti extabuerunt consumpti ab sterilitate terrae
clem: Teth Melius fuit occisis gladio quam interfectis fame, quoniam isti extabuerunt consumpti a sterilitate terr.
kjv: They that be slain with the sword are better than they that be slain with hunger: for these pine away, stricken through for want of the fruits of the field.

wlc: יְדֵי נָשִׁים רַחֲמָנִיּוֹת בִּשְּׁלוּ יַלְדֵיהֶן הָיוּ לְבָרוֹת לָמוֹ בְּשֶׁבֶר בַּת־עַמִּי ׃ ס
lxx: Ἰώδ. Χεῖρες γυναικῶν οἰκτειρμόναων ἥψησαν τὰ παιδία αὐτῶν, ἐγενήθησαν εἰς βρῶσιν αὐταῖς ἐν τῷ συντρίμματι τῆς θυγατρὸς λαοῦ μου.
vulg: IOTH manus mulierum misericordium coxerunt filios suos facti sunt cibus earum in contritione filiae populi mei
clem: Jod Manus mulierum misericordium coxerunt filios suos; facti sunt cibus earum in contritione fili populi mei.
kjv: The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children: they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people.

wlc: כִּלָּה יְהוָה אֶת־חֲמָתוֹ שָׁפַךְ חֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ וַיַּצֶּת־אֵשׁ בְּצִיּוֹן וַתֹּאכַל יְסוֹדֹתֶיהָ ׃ ס
lxx: Χάφ. Συνετέλεσεν Κύριος θυμὸν αὐτοῦ, ἐξέχεεν θυμὸν ὀργῆς αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἀνῆψεν πῦρ ἐν Σειών, καὶ κατέφαγεν τὰ θεμέλια αὐτῆς.
vulg: CAPH conplevit Dominus furorem suum effudit iram indignationis suae et succendit ignem in Sion et devoravit fundamenta eius
clem: Caph Complevit Dominus furorem suum, effudit iram indignationis su: et succendit ignem in Sion, et devoravit fundamenta ejus.
kjv: The Lord hath accomplished his fury; he hath poured out his fierce anger, and hath kindled a fire in Zion, and it hath devoured the foundations thereof.

wlc: לֹא הֶאֱמִינוּ מַלְכֵי־אֶרֶץ וְכֹל יֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל כִּי יָבֹא צַר וְאוֹיֵב בְּשַׁעֲרֵי יְרוּשָׁלִָם ׃ ס
lxx: Αάβδ. Οὐκ ἐπίστευσαν βασιλεῖς γῆς, πάντες οἱ κατοικοῦντες τὴν οἰκουμένην, ὅτι εἰσελεύσεται ἐχθρὸς καὶ ἐκθλίίδων διὰ τῶν πυλῶν Ἰε. ρουσαλήμ.
vulg: LAMED non crediderunt reges terrae et universi habitatores orbis quoniam ingrederetur hostis et inimicus per portas Hierusalem
clem: Lamed Non crediderunt reges terr, et universi habitatores orbis, quoniam ingrederetur hostis et inimicus per portas Jerusalem.
kjv: The kings of the earth, and all the inhabitants of the world, would not have believed that the adversary and the enemy should have entered into the gates of Jerusalem.

wlc: מֵחַטֹּאת נְבִיאֶיהָ עֲוֹנוֹת כֹּהֲנֶיהָ הַשֹּׁפְכִים בְּקִרְבָּהּ דַּם צַדִּיקִים ׃ ס
lxx: Μήμ. Ἐξ ἁμαρτιῶν προφητῶν αὐτῆς, ἀδικιῶν ἱερέων αὐτῆς, τῶν εκχεοντων αἶμα δίκαιον ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς.
vulg: MEM propter peccata prophetarum eius iniquitates sacerdotum eius qui effuderunt in medio eius sanguinem iustorum
clem: Mem Propter peccata prophetarum ejus, et iniquitates sacerdotum ejus, qui effuderunt in medio ejus sanguinem justorum.
kjv: For the sins of her prophets, and the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her,

wlc: נָעוּ עִוְרִים בַּחוּצוֹת נְגֹאֲלוּ בַּדָּם בְּלֹא יוּכְלוּ יִגְּעוּ בִּלְבֻשֵׁיהֶם ׃ ס
lxx: Nούν. Ἐσαλεύθησαν ἐγρήγοροι αὐτῆς ἐν ταῖς ἐξόδοις, ἐμολύνθησαν ἐν αἵματι ἐν τῷ μὴ δύνασθαι αὐτούς, ἥψαντο ἐνδυμάτων αὐτῶν.
vulg: NUN erraverunt caeci in plateis polluti sunt sanguine cumque non possent tenuerunt lacinias suas
clem: Nun Erraverunt cci in plateis, polluti sunt in sanguine; cumque non possent, tenuerunt lacinias suas.
kjv: They have wandered as blind men in the streets, they have polluted themselves with blood, so that men could not touch their garments.

wlc: סוּרוּ טָמֵא קָרְאוּ לָמוֹ סוּרוּ סוּרוּ אַל־תִּגָּעוּ כִּי נָצוּ גַּם־נָעוּ אָמְרוּ בַּגּוֹיִם לֹא יוֹסִיפוּ לָגוּר ׃ ס
lxx: Σάμεχ. Ἀπόστητε ἀκαθάρτων, καλέσατε αὐτοὺς Ἀπόστητε ἀπόστητε, μὴ ἄπτεσθε, ὅτι ἀνήφθησαν καί γε ἐσαλεύθησαν· εἶπατε ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν οὐ μὴ προσθῶσιν τοῦ παροικεῖν.
vulg: SAMECH recedite polluti clamaverunt eis recedite abite nolite tangere iurgati quippe sunt et commoti dixerunt inter gentes non addet ultra ut habitet in eis
clem: Samech Recedite polluti, clamaverunt eis; recedite, abite, nolite tangere: jurgati quippe sunt, et commoti dixerunt inter gentes: Non addet ultra ut habitet in eis.
kjv: They cried unto them, Depart ye; it is unclean; depart, depart, touch not: when they fled away and wandered, they said among the heathen, They shall no more sojourn there.

wlc: פְּנֵי יְהוָה חִלְּקָם לֹא יוֹסִיף לְהַבִּיטָם פְּנֵי כֹהֲנִים לֹא נָשָׂאוּ זְקֵנִים לֹא חָנָנוּ ׃ ס
lxx: Ἄιν. Πρόσωπον Κυρίου μερὶς αὐτῶν, οὐ προσθήσει ἐπιβλέψαι αὐτοῖς· πρόσωπον ἱερέων οὐκ ἔλαβον, προφήτας οὐκ ἠλέησαν.
vulg: FE facies Domini divisit eos non addet ut respiciat eos facies sacerdotum non erubuerunt neque senum miserti sunt
clem: Phe Facies Domini divisit eos, non addet ut respiciat eos; facies sacerdotum non erubuerunt, neque senum miserti sunt.
kjv: The anger of the Lord hath divided them; he will no more regard them: they respected not the persons of the priests, they favoured not the elders.

wlc: עוֹדֵינָה תִּכְלֶינָה עֵינֵינוּ אֶל־עֶזְרָתֵנוּ הָבֶל בְּצִפִּיָּתֵנוּ צִפִּינוּ אֶל־גּוֹי לֹא יוֹשִׁעַ ׃ ס
lxx: Φή. Ἔτι ὄντων ἡμῶν ἐξέλιπον οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ἡμῶν, εἰς τὴν βοήθειαν ἡμῶν μάταια ἀποσκοπευόντων ἡμῶν.
vulg: AIN cum adhuc subsisteremus defecerunt oculi nostri ad auxilium nostrum vanum cum respiceremus adtenti ad gentem quae salvare non poterat
clem: Ain Cum adhuc subsisteremus, defecerunt oculi nostri ad auxilium nostrum vanum; cum respiceremus attenti ad gentem qu salvare non poterat.
kjv: As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.

wlc: צָדוּ צְעָדֵינוּ מִלֶּכֶת בִּרְחֹבֹתֵינוּ קָרַב קִצֵּינוּ מָלְאוּ יָמֵינוּ כִּי־בָא קִצֵּינוּ ׃ ס
lxx: Ταδή. Ἀπεσκοπεύσαμεν εἰς ἔθνος οὐ σῶζον, ἐθηρεύσαμεν μικροὺς ἡμῶν τοῦ μὴ πορεύεσθαι ἐν ταῖς πλατείαις ἡμῶν.
vulg: SADE lubricaverunt vestigia nostra in itinere platearum nostrarum adpropinquavit finis noster conpleti sunt dies nostri quia venit finis noster
clem: Sade Lubricaverunt vestigia nostra in itinere platearum nostrarum; appropinquavit finis noster, completi sunt dies nostri, quia venit finis noster.
kjv: They hunt our steps, that we cannot go in our streets: our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end is come.

wlc: קַלִּים הָיוּ רֹדְפֵינוּ מִנִּשְׁרֵי שָׁמָיִם עַל־הֶהָרִים דְּלָקֻנוּ בַּמִּדְבָּר אָרְבוּ לָנוּ ׃ ס
lxx: Κὼφ. Ἤγγικεν ὁ καιρὸς ἡμῶν, ἐπληρώθησαν αἱ ἡμέραι ἡμῶν, πάρεστιν ὁ καιρὸς ἡμῶν· κοῦφοι ἐγένοντο οἱ διώκοντες ἡμᾶς ὑπέρ ἀετοὺς οὐρανοῦ, ἐπὶ τῶν ὀρέων ἐξέπτησαν, ἐν ἐρήμῳ ἐνήδρευσαν ἡμᾶς.
vulg: COPH velociores fuerunt persecutores nostri aquilis caeli super montes persecuti sunt nos in deserto insidiati sunt nobis
clem: Coph Velociores fuerunt persecutores nostri aquilis cli; super montes persecuti sunt nos, in deserto insidiati sunt nobis.
kjv: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven: they pursued us upon the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.

wlc: רוּחַ אַפֵּינוּ מְשִׁיחַ יְהוָה נִלְכַּד בִּשְׁחִיתוֹתָם אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְנוּ בְּצִלּוֹ נִחְיֶה בַגּוֹיִם ׃ ס
lxx: 'Ρήχς. Πνεῦμα προσώπου ἡμῶν χριστὸς Κύριος συνελήμφθη ἐν ταῖς διαφθοραῖς αὐτῶν, οὖ εἶπαμεν Ἐν τῇ σκιῷ αὐτοῦ ζησόμεθα ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν.
vulg: RES spiritus oris nostri christus dominus captus est in peccatis nostris cui diximus in umbra tua vivemus in gentibus
clem: Res Spiritus oris nostri, christus Dominus, captus est in peccatis nostris, cui diximus: In umbra tua vivemus in gentibus.
kjv: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the Lord, was taken in their pits, of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen.

wlc: שִׂישִׂי וְשִׂמְחִי בַּת־אֱדוֹם יוֹשַׁבְתִּי בְּאֶרֶץ עוּץ גַּם־עָלַיִךְ תַּעֲבָר־כּוֹס תִּשְׁכְּרִי וְתִתְעָרִי ׃ ס
lxx: Χσέν. Χαῖρε καὶ εὐφραίνου, θύγατερ Ἰδουμαίας ἡ κατοικοῦσα ἐπὶ γῆς. καί γε ἐπὶ σὲ διελεύσεται τὸ ποτήριον Κυρίου, μεθυσθήσῃ καὶ ἀποχεεῖς.
vulg: SEN gaude et laetare filia Edom quae habitas in terra Hus ad te quoque perveniet calix inebriaberis atque nudaberis
clem: Sin Gaude et ltare, filia Edom, qu habitas in terra Hus! ad te quoque perveniet calix: inebriaberis, atque nudaberis.
kjv: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz; the cup also shall pass through unto thee: thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked.

wlc: תַּם־עֲוֹנֵךְ בַּת־צִיּוֹן לֹא יוֹסִיף לְהַגְלוֹתֵךְ פָּקַד עֲוֹנֵךְ בַּת־אֱדוֹם גִּלָּה עַל־חַטֹּאתָיִךְ ׃ פ
lxx: θαύ Ἐξέλιπεν ἡ ἀνομία σου, θύγατερ Σειών, οὐ προσθήσει ἀποικίσαι σε. ἐπεσκέψατο ἀνομίας σου, θυγάτηρ Ἐδώμ, ἀπεκάλυψεν ἐπὶ τὰ ἀσεβήματά σου.
vulg: THAU conpleta est iniquitas tua filia Sion non addet ultra ut transmigret te visitavit iniquitatem tuam filia Edom discoperuit peccata tua
clem: Thau Completa est iniquitas tua, filia Sion: non addet ultra ut transmigret te. Visitavit iniquitatem tuam, filia Edom; discooperuit peccata tua.]
kjv: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry thee away into captivity: he will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover thy sins.

wlc: זְכֹר יְהוָה מֶה־הָיָה לָנוּ הַבֵּיט וּרְאֵה אֶת־חֶרְפָּתֵנוּ ׃
lxx: Μνήσθητι, Κύριε, ὅ τι ἐγενήθη ἡμῖν, ἐπίκκβλεψον καὶ ἴδε τὸν ὀνειδισμὸν ἡμῶν.
vulg: recordare Domine quid acciderit nobis intuere et respice obprobrium nostrum
clem: [Recordare, Domine, quid acciderit nobis; intuere et respice opprobrium nostrum.
kjv: Remember, O Lord, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.

wlc: נַחֲלָתֵנוּ נֶהֶפְכָה לְזָרִים בָּתֵּינוּ לְנָכְרִים ׃
lxx: κληρονομία ἡμῶν μετεστράφη ἀλλοτρίοις, οἱ οἶκοι ἡμῶν ξένοις.
vulg: hereditas nostra versa est ad alienos domus nostrae ad extraneos
clem: Hreditas nostra versa est ad alienos, domus nostr ad extraneos.
kjv: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.

wlc: יְתוֹמִים הָיִינוּ אֵין אָב אִמֹּתֵינוּ כְּאַלְמָנוֹת ׃
lxx: ὀρφανοὶ ἐγενήθημεν, οὐχ ὑπάρχει πατήρ, μητέρες ἡμῶν ὡς αἱ χῆραι.
vulg: pupilli facti sumus absque patre matres nostrae quasi viduae
clem: Pupilli facti sumus absque patre, matres nostr quasi vidu.
kjv: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers are as widows.

wlc: מֵימֵינוּ בְּכֶסֶף שָׁתִינוּ עֵצֵינוּ בִּמְחִיר יָבֹאוּ ׃
lxx: ἐξ ἡμερῶν ἡμῶν ξύλα ἡμῶν ἐν ἀλλάγματι ἦλθεν·
vulg: aquam nostram pecunia bibimus ligna nostra pretio conparavimus
clem: Aquam nostram pecunia bibimus; ligna nostra pretio comparavimus.
kjv: We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.

wlc: עַל צַוָּארֵנוּ נִרְדָּפְנוּ יָגַעְנוּ לֹא הוּנַח־לָנוּ ׃
lxx: ἐπὶ τὸν τράχηλον ἡμῶν ἐδιώχθημεν· ἐκοπιάσαμεν, οὐκ ἀνεπαύθημεν.
vulg: cervicibus minabamur lassis non dabatur requies
clem: Cervicibus nostris minabamur, lassis non dabatur requies.
kjv: Our necks are under persecution: we labour, and have no rest.

wlc: מִצְרַיִם נָתַנּוּ יָד אַשּׁוּר לִשְׂבֹּעַ לָחֶם ׃
lxx: Aἶγυπτος ἔδωκεν χείρα. Ἀσσοὺρ εἰς πλησμονὴν αὐτῶν.
vulg: Aegypto dedimus manum et Assyriis ut saturaremur pane
clem: gypto dedimus manum et Assyriis, ut saturaremur pane.
kjv: We have given the hand to the Egyptians, and to the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.

wlc: אֲבֹתֵינוּ חָטְאוּ אֵינָם ַאֲנַחְנוּ עֲוֹנֹתֵיהֶם סָבָלְנוּ ׃
lxx: οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν ἥμαρτον, οὐχ ὑπάρχουσιν, ἡμεῖς τὰ ἀνομήματα αὐτῶν ὑπέσχομεν.
vulg: patres nostri peccaverunt et non sunt et nos iniquitates eorum portavimus
clem: Patres nostri peccaverunt, et non sunt: et nos iniquitates eorum portavimus.
kjv: Our fathers have sinned, and are not; and we have borne their iniquities.

wlc: עֲבָדִים מָשְׁלוּ בָנוּ פֹּרֵק אֵין מִיָּדָם ׃
lxx: δοῦλοι ἐκυρίευσαν ἡμῶν, λυτρούμενος οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τῆς χειρὸς αὐτῶν.
vulg: servi dominati sunt nostri non fuit qui redimeret de manu eorum
clem: Servi dominati sunt nostri: non fuit qui redimeret de manu eorum.
kjv: Servants have ruled over us: there is none that doth deliver us out of their hand.

wlc: בְּנַפְשֵׁנוּ נָבִיא לַחְמֵנוּ מִפְּנֵי חֶרֶב הַמִּדְבָּר ׃
lxx: ἐν ταῖς ψυχαῖς ἡμῶν εἰσοίσομεν ἄρτον ἡμῶν ἀπὸ προσώπου όομφαίας τῆς ἐρήμου.
vulg: in animabus nostris adferebamus panem nobis a facie gladii in deserto
clem: In animabus nostris afferebamus panem nobis, a facie gladii in deserto.
kjv: We gat our bread with the peril of our lives because of the sword of the wilderness.

wlc: עוֹרֵנוּ כְּתַנּוּר נִכְמָרוּ מִפְּנֵי זַלְעֲפוֹת רָעָב ׃
lxx: τὸ δέρμα ἡμῶν ὡς κλίβανος ἐπελιώθη, συνεσπάσθησαν ἀπὸ προσώπου καταιγίδων λιμοῦ.
vulg: pellis nostra quasi clibanus exusta est a facie tempestatum famis
clem: Pellis nostra quasi clibanus exusta est, a facie tempestatum famis.
kjv: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.

wlc: נָשִׁים בְּצִיּוֹן עִנּוּ בְּתֻלֹת בְּעָרֵי יְהוּדָה ׃
lxx: γυναῖκας ἐν Σειὼν ἐταπείνωσαν, παρθένους ἐν πόλεσιν Ἰούδα.
vulg: mulieres in Sion humiliaverunt virgines in civitatibus Iuda
clem: Mulieres in Sion humiliaverunt, et virgines in civitatibus Juda.
kjv: They ravished the women in Zion, and the maids in the cities of Judah.

wlc: שָׂרִים בְּיָדָם נִתְלוּ פְּנֵי זְקֵנִים לֹא נֶהְדָּרוּ ׃
lxx: ἄρχοντες ἐν χερσὶν αὐτῶν ἐκρεμάσθησαν, πρεσβύτεροι οὐκ ἐδοξάσθησαν.
vulg: principes manu suspensi sunt facies senum non erubuerunt
clem: Principes manu suspensi sunt; facies senum non erubuerunt.
kjv: Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.

wlc: בַּחוּרִים טְחוֹן נָשָׂאוּ וּנְעָרִים בָּעֵץ כָּשָׁלוּ ׃
lxx: ἐκλεκτοὶ κλαυθμὸν ἀνέλαβον, καὶ νεανίσκοι ἐν ξύλῳ ἠσθένησαν.
vulg: adulescentibus inpudice abusi sunt et pueri in ligno corruerunt
clem: Adolescentibus impudice abusi sunt, et pueri in ligno corruerunt.
kjv: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.

wlc: זְקֵנִים מִשַּׁעַר שָׁבָתוּ בַּחוּרִים מִנְּגִינָתָם ׃
lxx: καὶ πρεσβῦται ἀπὸ πύλης κατέπαυσαν, ἐκλεκτοὶ ἐκ ψαλμῶν αὐτῶν κατέπαυσαν,
vulg: senes de portis defecerunt iuvenes de choro psallentium
clem: Senes defecerunt de portis, juvenes de choro psallentium.
kjv: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their musick.

wlc: שָׁבַת מְשׂוֹשׂ לִבֵּנוּ נֶהְפַּךְ לְאֵבֶל מְחֹלֵנוּ ׃
lxx: κατέλυσεν χαρὰ καρδίας ἡμῶν, ἐστράφη εἰς πένθος ὁ χορὸς ἡμῶν,
vulg: defecit gaudium cordis nostri versus est in luctu chorus noster
clem: Defecit gaudium cordis nostri; versus est in luctum chorus noster.
kjv: The joy of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.

wlc: נָפְלָה עֲטֶרֶת רֹאשֵׁנוּ אוֹי־נָא לָנוּ כִּי חָטָאנוּ ׃
lxx: ἔπεσεν ὁ στέφανος ἡμῶν τῆς κεφαλῆς. οὐαὶ δὴ ἡμῖν, ὅτι ἡμάρτομεν.
vulg: cecidit corona capitis nostri vae nobis quia peccavimus
clem: Cecidit corona capitis nostri: v nobis, quia peccavimus!
kjv: The crown is fallen from our head: woe unto us, that we have sinned!

wlc: עַל־זֶה הָיָה דָוֶה לִבֵּנוּ עַל־אֵלֶּה חָשְׁכוּ עֵינֵינוּ ׃
lxx: περὶ τούτου ἐγενήθη ὀδύνη ὀδυνηρὰ ἡ καρδία ἡμῶν. περὶ τούτου ἐσκότασαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ἡμῶν.
vulg: propterea maestum factum est cor nostrum ideo contenebrati sunt oculi nostri
clem: Propterea mstum factum est cor nostrum; ideo contenebrati sunt oculi nostri,
kjv: For this our heart is faint; for these things our eyes are dim.

wlc: עַל הַר־צִיּוֹן שֶׁשָּׁמֵם שׁוּעָלִים הִלְּכוּ־בוֹ ׃ פ
lxx: ἐπ᾿ ὄρος Σειών, ὅτι ἠφανίσθη, ἀλώπεκες διῆλθον ἐν αὐτῇ.
vulg: propter montem Sion quia disperiit vulpes ambulaverunt in eo
clem: propter montem Sion quia disperiit; vulpes ambulaverunt in eo.
kjv: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, the foxes walk upon it.

wlc: אַתָּה יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם תֵּשֵׁב כִּסְאֲךָ לְדֹר וָדוֹר ׃
lxx: σὺ δέ, Κύριε, εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα κατοικήσεις, ὁ θρόνος σου εἰς γενεὰν καὶ γενεάν.
vulg: tu autem Domine in aeternum permanebis solium tuum in generatione et generatione
clem: Tu autem, Domine, in ternum permanebis, solium tuum in generationem et generationem.
kjv: Thou, O Lord, remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.

wlc: לָמָּה לָנֶצַח תִּשְׁכָּחֵנוּ תַּעַזְבֵנוּ לְאֹרֶךְ יָמִים ׃
lxx: ζνα τί εἰς νῖκος ἐπιλήσῃ ἡμῶν; καταλείψεις ἡμᾶς εἰς μακρότητα ἡμερῶν;
vulg: quare in perpetuum oblivisceris nostri derelinques nos in longitudinem dierum
clem: Quare in perpetuum oblivisceris nostri, derelinques nos in longitudine dierum?
kjv: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, and forsake us so long time?

wlc: הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ יְהוָה אֵלֶיךָ וְנָשׁוּב חַדֵּשׁ יָמֵינוּ כְּקֶדֶם ׃
lxx: ἐπίστρεψον ἡμᾶς, Κύριε, πρὸς σέ, καὶ ἐπιστραφησόμεθα· καὶ ἀνακαίνισον ἡμέρας ἡμῶν καθὼς ἔμπροσθεν.
vulg: converte nos Domine ad te et convertemur innova dies nostros sicut a principio
clem: Converte nos, Domine, ad te, et convertemur; innova dies nostros, sicut a principio.
kjv: Turn thou us unto thee, O Lord, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.

wlc: כִּי אִם־מָאֹס מְאַסְתָּנוּ קָצַפְתָּ עָלֵינוּ עַד־מְאֹד ׃
lxx: ὅτι ἀπωθούμενος ἀπώσω ἡμᾶς, ὐργίσθης ἐφʼ ἡμᾶς ἕως σφόδρα.
vulg: sed proiciens reppulisti nos iratus es contra nos vehementer
clem: Sed projiciens repulisti nos: iratus es contra nos vehementer.]
kjv: But thou hast utterly rejected us; thou art very wroth against us.
